data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination' in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona's rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self\-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world's most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long\-lasting, and cruelty\-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi\-faceted jeweled bottles.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative \& luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Director of NPD \& Projects will own and lead the global product development project management function, ensuring seamless execution across all stages of the product development lifecycle, spanning concept creation, feasibility assessment, development, launch readiness, and post\-launch optimization. This leadership role will drive adoption of a standardized Stage\-Gate model across all innovation projects, driving speed\-to\-market, cross\-functional alignment, and operational excellence at scale.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership \& NPD Excellence**
* Own and evolve KAYALI's Stage\-Gate product development framework, ensuring clear governance, decision\-making, and accountability across all phases of the lifecycle
* Define and govern stage gates, including entry/exit criteria, decision checkpoints, and escalation protocols
* Lead the development of the 24\-month global launch roadmap, ensuring alignment with brand, commercial, and supply strategies
* Drive continuous improvement of speed\-to\-market while balancing innovation, risk, and quality
* Act as the central point of accountability for on\-time, in\-full (OTIF) delivery of all launches globally


**Stage 0\-1: Concept \& Feasibility**
* Ensure robust front\-end innovation processes, including clear concept definition, consumer insight integration, and strategic opportunity sizing
* Oversee feasibility assessment across formula, packaging, regulatory, and supply capabilities
* Validate business cases (cost, margin, timelines, scale viability) prior to gate approval
* Align cross\-functional stakeholders on risk, trade\-offs, and go/no\-go decisions early in the process


**Stage 2: Development \& Validation**
* Oversee end\-to\-end development across all projects, ensuring alignment on timelines, KPIs, and quality standards
* Ensure rigorous management of formulation, packaging development, testing, and regulatory validation
* Drive disciplined milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and issue escalation across all active projects
* Build and maintain robust project timelines, ensuring proactive tracking, risk management, and milestone adherence
* Establish clear governance across projects, including stage gates, decision frameworks, and escalation protocols


**Stage 3: Industrialization \& Launch Readiness**
* Lead transition from development to production, ensuring readiness across manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics
* Oversee forecasting, demand alignment, and order placement in partnership with Demand Planning and Regional Markets
* Ensure all launch readiness criteria are met, including operational, commercial, and regulatory requirements
* Drive accountability for OTIF delivery across all launches


**Stage 4: Launch \& Post\-Launch Optimization**
* Track launch performance against defined KPIs, including sales, forecast accuracy, OTIF, and operational delivery
* Champion a mindset of innovation, agility, and continuous improvement
* Drive post\-launch reviews to capture learnings and inform future pipeline decisions
* Identify opportunities for optimization, reformulation, or lifecycle extension
* Embed continuous improvement across tools, processes, and ways of working to elevate efficiency and scalability


**Cross\-Functional Orchestration**
* Act as the central connector across all functions, ensuring alignment, accountability, and transparency across each stage gate \[JD \-Direct...dits).docx \| Word]
* Lead structured cross\-functional forums aligned to stage\-gate checkpoints
* Ensure clear communication of risks, priorities, and decisions to senior leadership


**Supplier \& External Partner Management**
* Ensure external partners are fully aligned to stage\-gate timelines, deliverables, and quality standards
* Integrate suppliers early in feasibility and development phases to de\-risk execution
* Drive accountability across manufacturing and supply partners through industrialization


**Risk Management \& Operational Excellence**
* Embed proactive risk identification and mitigation at each stage of the product lifecycle
* Establish structured "red flag" reporting tied to stage\-gate decision points


**Forecasting \& Launch Readiness**
* Oversee launch forecasting in collaboration with Demand Planning and Regional Markets
* Ensure accurate submission of forecasts and timely placement of orders for components and finished goods
* Drive excellence in launch readiness, ensuring all operational elements are aligned ahead of go\-live


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Lead and scale a high\-performing NPD \& Projects team, ensuring the right structure, capabilities, and resourcing to support business growth
* Set clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations across the team, driving accountability and ownership
* Coach and develop team members, providing ongoing feedback, mentorship, and career development support
* Foster a culture of collaboration, agility, and continuous improvement, aligned with KAYALI values
* Ensure strong resource planning and workload prioritization across projects to optimize team efficiency
* Partner with People \& Culture to attract, retain, and develop top talent within the function


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in New Product Development, Project Management, or Transformation within beauty, fragrance, or luxury consumer goods
* Proven track record of leading complex, cross\-functional global launches
* Strong expertise across product development and end\-to\-end supply chain processes
* Experience building and leading high\-performing teams
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels
* Strong strategic thinking combined with operational rigor and attention to detail
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Asana, MS Project, etc.)
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, founder\-led, high\-growth environment


**Benefits**
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* Find your Magic Days
* Volunteer Day
* Birthday Leave
* Egg Freezing Benefits
* Employee discounts on all Kayali products
* Quarterly product gifting


 KAYALI is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are**
 At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Complex Program Manager is responsible for leading and delivering large\-scale, high\-impact programs characterized by significant complexity, ambiguity, and cross\-functional dependencies. The role ensures alignment of program outcomes with strategic business objectives while managing scope, schedule, budget, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
   

  

 This position requires the ability to translate strategic vision into a portfolio of interconnected projects and drive successful execution through strong governance, leadership, and decision\-making capabilities.
   

  

**Program Leadership \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex transformation programs with multiple interdependent workstreams
* Translate strategic objectives into structured program roadmaps with clear milestones and deliverables
* Ensure alignment between program scope, contractual commitments, and business outcomes


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Establish and maintain robust governance frameworks aligned with organizational standards
* Identify, assess, and proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies
* Drive decision\-making through governance forums and executive\-level reporting


**Stakeholder \& Executive Management**
* Act as the primary interface for senior stakeholders, sponsors, and clients
* Manage stakeholder expectations, resolve conflicts, and ensure alignment across teams
* Provide clear, concise executive updates, insights, and recommendations


**Financial \& Commercial Management**
* Own program financials, including budgeting, forecasting, and margin management
* Ensure contractual and commercial compliance (SLAs, financial targets)
* Drive value realization and benefits tracking across the program lifecycle


**Planning \& Execution Oversight**
* Ensure integrated planning across all program workstreams
* Monitor performance using KPIs, milestones, and success metrics
* Implement corrective actions to address deviations in scope, schedule, cost, or quality


**People Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, mentor, and develop project managers and cross\-functional delivery teams
* Build high\-performing teams aligned with program objectives
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement


**Change \& Transformation Management**
* Assess organizational readiness and manage resistance to change
* Define and execute change management strategies
* Ensure delivery of measurable business outcomes and adoption of solutions


**Your Future at Kyndryl**
 Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
   

  

**Required Skills And Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in program/project management, with proven delivery of complex transformation programs
* Demonstrated experience managing large\-scale, cross\-functional, and multi\-vendor environments
* Strong leadership skills across complex, multi\-stream programs
* Advanced stakeholder management and executive communication capabilities
* Solid expertise in governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and margin management
* Strategic thinking with strong analytical and decision\-making skills
* High resilience, adaptability, and ability to operate in ambiguous environments


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
* Experience delivering large\-scale technology programs (Cloud, Digital Transformation, Data/AI, Enterprise Platforms)
* Proven track record working in global or highly matrixed organizations
* Experience driving organizational change and transformation initiatives
* Strong commercial awareness and experience managing contractual obligations
* Certifications: PMP / PgMP; PRINCE2 Practitioner; Other relevant program or portfolio management certifications


**Being You**
 The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
   

  

**What You Can Expect**
 Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
   

  

 From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
   

  

 We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
   

  

 We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
   

  

**Get Referred!**
 If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

data.jd_text:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for
 **Global Program Engineer Manager \- Digitalization.** 
 This role is a strategic, globally scoped position responsible for defining, deploying, and governing Eaton’s post‑order execution framework, PMO standards, and digital operating model across the Global Data Center Segment.
   

  

 This role ensures consistent, predictable, and scalable execution of complex, multi‑region data center programs by establishing global governance, driving digital adoption, and enabling transparency across order execution, engineering, services, and regional delivery teams. The position serves as the single point of accountability for PMO governance and digitalization within the Global Data Center Segment and operates as a key partner to regional leaders, functional owners, and global program teams.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Global PMO Governance**
* Define and own the global PMO governance model for post‑order execution across all regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC).
* Establish standardized program lifecycle frameworks, phase gates, escalation paths, and decision rights aligned with Eaton’s matrixed operating model.
* Ensure governance rigor for large, complex, and multi‑site data center programs, including hyperscale and strategic customer engagements.
* Act as the central authority for program health reviews, executive escalations, and cross‑regional issue resolution.


**Digitalization \& Tool Enablement**
* Lead the digital transformation of post‑order execution, driving adoption of standardized tools, dashboards, and digital workflows.
* Define global requirements for program visibility, KPI reporting, risk management, and forecast accuracy.
* Partner with Digital, IT, and functional teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Enable real‑time transparency for leadership through data‑driven insights and standardized reporting.


**Execution Excellence \& Performance Management**
* Define and govern global KPIs covering schedule adherence, cost performance, change management, execution risk, and customer commitments.
* Drive consistency in program cadence, review rhythms, and performance metrics across regions.
* Identify systemic execution gaps and lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve speed, predictability, and customer outcomes.
* Support post‑mortems and lessons‑learned processes to institutionalize best practices globally.


**Cross**

* Support organizational change management (OCM) for new governance models, tools, and ways of working.

* \+12 years of experience in program management, PMO leadership, or execution governance within complex, global organizations.
* Experience using Salesforce in an enterprise or global environment to support strategic customers, complex program execution, and multi‑region reporting.

* Experience supporting or governing post‑order, delivery, or execution‑heavy environments.

**Why Join Eaton**
* Competitive compensation and benefits, aligned with your experience and impact.
* Opportunity to work on challenging, high‑impact projects within a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
* Your aspirations matter – Eaton actively supports internal mobility and promotes from within whenever possible.
* Your growth matters – We invest in long‑term development through continuous learning, upskilling, and global programs via Eaton University.

* Your wellbeing matters – Health, safety, and wellness are a priority. At Eaton, wellbeing goes beyond programs, empowering employees with the tools and environment to thrive.

Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

data.jd_text:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Transformation Program Governance Director provides strategic oversight and leadership across the Group’s multi\-year digital transformation program. This role ensures disciplined execution, strategic alignment, and value realization across all streams, while acting as the guardian of program governance, standards, and vendor accountability. Operating at Group level, this leader drives cross\-entity alignment, embeds best\-in\-class governance frameworks, and establishes the program as a benchmark for disciplined transformation delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead executive governance for the entire digital transformation program, strategically allocating resources, budgets, and priorities to maximize business impact.
* Safeguard program outcomes by overseeing benefit realization and hold workstreams accountable for delivering measurable value and results.
* Support and challenge program leaders to ensure delivery excellence, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and barriers.
* Provide senior leadership with data\-driven insights, independent assurance, and strategic recommendations to guide decision\-making.
* Define, document and continuously evolve Group\-wide governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistent and mature program delivery.
* Establish and maintain a Transformation Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) offering tools, methodologies, and training for standardized delivery.
* Uphold governance rigor by designing and maintaining clear decision\-making structures, reporting mechanisms, and escalation protocols that ensure transparency and accountability at all levels.
* Act as a senior escalation point and manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring partners meet contractual commitments, quality standards, and timely delivery.
* Shape vendor engagement models and collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to optimize commercial terms, risk management and cost control across all vendor engagements.
* Ensure alignment across Group entities and business units, so that transformation initiatives are integrated seamlessly into the operating model and enable scalable adoption.
* Drive transparent, timely reporting and foster collaboration across geographies and functions to maintain senior stakeholder engagement and informed executive committees and SteerCos, enabling informed decision\-making and program steering.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Proven experience in leading governance and execution for large\-scale, multi\-year digital transformation programs, ideally in a multi\-entity or international group context.
* Deep expertise in governance design, operating models, and transformation frameworks, with a track record of institutionalizing standards at Group level.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to engage at C\-suite and Board level.
* Demonstrated success in vendor and partner governance, including complex system integrator or technology engagements.
* Strategic thinker with operational discipline, able to balance control, flexibility, and delivery speed.
* Excellent communication, diplomacy, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultures and functions.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Director of Project Execution** 
 who will
 **report directly to the Executive Management** 
 and oversee multiple airport BHS and MHS projects. You will provide guidance and leadership to the Project Execution and Site Management teams, foster collaboration across internal functions and external stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on\-time, on\-budget, contract compliant, and to the required quality through to handover.
   

  

**What are my responsibilities?**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of airport BHS/MHS programs, ensuring safe, on\-budget, contract\-compliant execution.
* Serve as senior client and stakeholder lead, aligning airport authorities/operators, consultants/PMCs, contractors, and internal teams.
* Own the full lifecycle from engineering coordination through installation, integration, testing, commissioning, ORAT, and handover to Service.
* Drive strong project governance (steerco, reviews, workshops), ensuring clear decisions, actions, and follow\-up.
* Manage portfolio performance across multi\-site/multi\-country matrix teams; control KPIs, risk, change, and escalations, including recovery/turnaround.
* Ensure effective site execution in live airport environments, including M\&E installation, upgrades, brownfield works, and system interface management.
* Ensure completeness and quality of technical/contract documentation and reporting across the project lifecycle.
* Lead successful handovers to Life\-Cycle Services, ensuring continuity, training, spares, warranty transition, and sign\-off.
* Support Sales \& Bid activities to develop opportunities and ensure executable delivery strategies and resourcing inputs.
* Build and lead high\-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**What do I need to qualify for the role?**
* 10\+ years delivering complex engineering/automation/site projects; strong ownership of cost, schedule, quality, and safety.
* Proven leadership in multi\-stakeholder environments with strong client\-facing and executive communication capability.
* Strong experience in airport BHS or MHS systems including site execution and commissioning; ORAT exposure is a plus.
* Solid understanding of automation integration environments (mechanical/electrical, PLC/SCADA/controls, interfaces).
* Strong commercial and contractual discipline: change control, risk/opportunity management, claims awareness.
* Proficient in project tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, MS Office; Jira/Confluence is a plus).
* Willingness to travel and operate in dynamic airport environments.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

data.jd_text:
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
   

  

 Thales people architect solutions that enable two\-thirds of planes to take off and land safely. We create in\-flight entertainment systems that engross 50 million fliers every year and we develop the avionics that control the world’s largest commercial aircrafts. Our simulators train the next generation of pilots for fighter jets, transporters and search and rescue helicopters. And, together, each and every member of our aerospace team makes a difference.
   

  

 For over 50 years, Thales has been a trusted partner of the United Arab Emirates, providing innovative and cutting\-edge solutions in Defence, Aeropsace and Cyber \& Digital, aligned with the nation’s long\-term vision. With a strong local presence and more than 500 employees across three offices, Thales is deeply embedded within the UAE’s ecosystem. Thales Emarat Technologies plays a pivotal role as a key industrial enabler, fostering national sovereignty, self\-reliance, and innovation. Through localization, strategic collaboration, and exporting ‘Made in the Emirates’ technologies to global markets, we contribute significantly to the UAE’s ambitious growth and development while helping build a future we call all trust.
   

  

 Responsible for supporting the Emirates VP Program Manager as well as the respective PM Directors based in the USA in the execution of the Emirates Programs from Sales handover through delivery of the final aircraft and closure of commitment letter items. Additionally, responsible for leading and directing the Discovery Dubai (DD) employees (Content Integration team members, LFM (lab facility management) and other local engineers) in coordination with their respective US based organizational leaders. In coordination with the USA PM Leadership, be responsible for the cost and schedule performance and risk management for the Emirates Programs. Coordinates with internal Thales organizations, to communicate customer requirements and execute the program with technical accuracy, consistency and profitability as well as managing the communications and relations with customer/s.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* As the local PM, support the PM Directors in meeting on a regular (daily preferred – at least once per week) with key Emirates representatives at the Emirates Offices or hosting Emirates within DD and clearly communicate key messages from Emirates to Thales teammates (PM team in the USA, AGS (USA and Dubai) and Sales Team (Dubai).
* As the local PM, represents the USA PM Team by attending (in person as needed) Dubai morning meetings and passing key information and actions back to the USA PM and Engineering teammates.
* As the local PM, represents the USA PM Team by attending the In\-Service performance reviews at Emirates along with AGS teammates and being the PM focal for in\-service issues while keeping USA Teammates well informed and secured USA support as required.
* Lead the DD Team to ensure they have defined work scope with clear deliverables in accordance with Customer and Program requirements and milestone objectives for both H/W and S/W topics . . . as required local DD labs, Irvine HW and SW development activities.
* Support the bid process for Sales and Bid Management, by developing Program Management bid inputs, identifying risks and coordinating technical responses.
* Participate in the handover meeting from Sales and Bid Management to Program Management.
* Coordinate with the functional managers to identify and establish a cross\-functional program team in accordance with the established Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
* Develop the program Bill of Materials (BOM). Identify risk areas and seek to stabilize the BOM as early in the program as possible in order to satisfy contractual deliveries.
* Conduct the internal program Kick Off Meeting (KOM) to facilitate communication of the airline customer expectations, and the delivery schedule for parts/services and documentation necessary
* Ensure Internal Change Orders (ICOs) are released in a timely manner within normal production lead times, to the maximum extent allowed by the customer agreement.
* Direct and oversee program activities to assure the accomplishment of program objectives in a profitable way that meets or exceeds customer and Thales expectations.
* For new programs, implement the Manage Program (MAP) program tracking tool. Once the MAP is set up, maintain and update of the program MAP on a frequent basis. Ensure that accurate program records are maintained in accordance with current document retention and filing processes.
* Maintain a program master schedule including key program milestones, technical data deliverables and critical path decision gates
* Conduct regular program team meetings to review schedule performance, cost performance BOM status, risk areas and customer satisfaction. Risk management is a key role of a program manager inclusive of documentation in accordance with the current risk management tracking tools.
* Routinely assess program financial profit and loss data for the assigned program. Monitor non\-recurring cost expenditures to ensure alignment with program budgets and spending plan. Manage budget changes, monitor actual expenditures and estimate financials at program completion as well as the work remaining to complete the program. Coordinate closely with finance.
* Correspond directly with the external airline customer, aircraft manufacturer and seat supplier as directed and approved by the supervising Program Manager. Ensure all correspondence is high quality, accurate and timely and respects the intellectual property agreements in place.
* Prepare for, and participate in, program milestone meetings such as Preliminary Design Reviews (PDRs), Critical Design Reviews (CDRs), First Article Inspections (FAIs), Program Management Reviews (PMRs) and other applicable meetings.
* Assist the Finance Department in receipt of Purchase Orders (POs) from airline customers and aircraft manufacturers. Ensure POs are received in advance of committed shipping dates to avoid potential revenue gaps and customer satisfaction issues.
* Close the project (archiving documents, closing expenditure authorizations) by capitalizing and sharing the enterprise experience.


**Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language**
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field with a minimum of 7\-9\+ years of experience or a Master’s degree in a related field with a minimum of 5\+ years of experience.
* A minimum of 5 years of project management or PMO experience
* Demonstrated customer facing skill set with high level decision makers
* Proven financial savvy specifically in business case development and value proposition
* Must be able to work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and efficiency
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from various stakeholders.
* Strong numerical skills and expert capabilities with analyzing large data sets using excel
* Able to proficiently operate MS Office applications, i.e., Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Visio.
* Strong interpersonal communications skills and the ability to motivate others
* Ability to manage multiple time sensitive projects and work independently


**Qualifications**
* IPMA or PMP Certification preferred
* Experience working in the aviation industry or on international avionics projects
* FAA Certification experience
* Familiarity with SAP, Primavera, Microsoft Project tools.
* Demonstrates accountability and leadership competencies to lead teams as well as individual business results
* Well versed and have hands on experience to demonstrate competence on below aspects of Project Management in a fast\-paced international business environment where daily decision making and actions are required
* Project Planning \- able to consolidate and document the fundamental components of a project such as requirements, scope, schedule, resource planning, budgets, risks and quality requirements to produce a quality change order
* Customer Relations Management \- understand the customer through the hard and soft information that is received to ensure that the bid/project deliverables mirror the customer’s vision and philosophy as closely as possible.
* Budgeting and Cost Control \- develop and agree project budgets. It comprises of the estimation of costs, setting the agreed baseline budget and the management of actual and forecast costs against the baseline budget. Manage costs within the agreed budget and accurately analyze and manage variances.
* Schedule and Resource Management – prepare and maintain schedules of activities, phases and milestones for projects, taking account of dependencies between activities and resources constraints. It also requires robust monitoring and reporting of progress against the baseline schedule and forecasting project completion.
* Risk and Opportunity Management \- identify risks throughout the project lifecycle using a number of techniques, assess probability and impact of risks with subject matter experts and create mitigation plans.
* Change Control \- capture and evaluate all requests to alter baselines (requirements, scope, schedule, costs etc.) of projects. Apply a formal change control process in agreement with customer
* Project Governance – apply of Thales project management processes and procedures to ensure consistent delivery of projects which includes understanding and adherence to governance processes, establishing clear roles and responsibilities and conducting robust internal and independent project reviews.


**Physical Demand**
 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and fingers to handle or feel; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand.
   

  

**Special Position Requirements**
* Schedule: Core business hours, Monday through Friday. May be required to occasionally work outside core business hours. Requires flexibility to manage international customer.
* Physical Environment: Please select this box if this position will require access to specialized work areas, e.g. manufacturing/production area, R\&D lab, warehouse. If checked, please indicate the primary environment(s) where this position is required to work è Airbus and Boeing FAL production sites, BFE supplier sites and visit to Emirates line maintenance locations (hangar and other Dubai airport terminal locations) with the applicable Emirates authorization,
* Travel: Up to 50% domestic and international travel depending on the specific customer.
* Customer Location Based or Site Visits: This position will require travel to/from customer offices (Dubai \- driving personal vehicle), supplier sites (via air travel) and the US home office site (via air travel)
* Personal or Company/Pool Vehicle Usage: Please select this box if this position will be issued a company vehicle or will be required to use their personal vehicle for travel to/from customer offices in Dubai to perform the essential functions of the position.

Publicis Groupe and Beiersdorf have created Publicis One Touch for their next digital transformation, a new type of agency model based on agility and interdisciplinary design. Publicis One Touch is designed to build a truly connected NIVEA marketing ecosystem, with data at its heart, to work with a single, connected view of marketing adoption and performance, brand health and customer insights across the entire customer journey to drive efficiency, effectiveness and brand love.
 



  





 Job Description
 



 The candidate will be responsible for leading integrated business delivery across assigned Emerging Markets hubs, with a primary focus on
 **India and ASEAN markets** 
 , combining client leadership with cross\-functional integration, operational governance, and commercial ownership.
 



 This is a hybrid leadership role requiring strong business acumen, structured operational oversight, and the ability to navigate complex multi\-market workstreams across Creative, Account Management, Production, Impact, Last Mile, and regional leadership teams.
 



 Given the operational complexity and pace of the India and ASEAN business, the role requires a highly collaborative and solutions\-oriented leader who understands the nuances of these markets, can connect multiple stakeholders, proactively identify risks, and ensure seamless delivery across evolving workstreams.
 



 The role will work closely with senior leadership, regional hub teams, and client stakeholders to ensure delivery excellence, operational discipline, and continuous process improvement across the POUL operating model.
 



 The candidate will also be responsible for mentoring and guiding junior team members while strengthening integration between India, ASEAN, and wider regional delivery teams.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



**Technical \& Product** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of integrated campaigns and content workstreams across assigned India and ASEAN hubs, ensuring smooth transition from creative development through production and implementation.
* Act as the integration conduit across CDU (regional), Impact, Last Mile, Production, Creative, and teams.
* Maintain clear visibility across ongoing projects, milestones, dependencies, approvals, and delivery risks.
* Ensure project workflows align with agreed POUL / CDU ways of working and governance frameworks.
* Support creative development workflows including concept development, testing, storyboard / animatic development, production readiness, and digital adaptation.
* Guide teams on practical delivery solutions under compressed timelines and evolving business requirements.
* Ensure teams are aligned on ownership, roles, responsibilities, and next steps across workstreams.
* Bring practical understanding of delivery realities across India and ASEAN markets, including local stakeholder dynamics, operational dependencies, and regional nuances.



**Business Acumen \& Operational Efficiency** 



* Build trusted relationships with regional and local clients, positioning the team as a strategic and dependable business partner.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of client business priorities, operational realities, market nuances, and delivery challenges.
* Lead operational governance across assigned workstreams, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to expected quality standards.
* Proactively identify risks, escalation points, resource gaps, and operational blockers; drive timely resolution within internal teams.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline across projects, including PO tracking, billing readiness, burn rate awareness, forecasting support, and financial escalations.
* Drive structured project management and disciplined follow\-through across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Improve efficiency across teams by identifying process gaps, operational inefficiencies, and handover challenges, and recommending scalable solutions.
* Support regional leadership in managing complex delivery scenarios, compressed timelines, and evolving client asks across India and ASEAN hubs.



**Innovative \& Analytical Mindset** 



* Think strategically and operationally to solve business and delivery challenges across complex multi\-market workstreams.
* Join the dots across clients, internal teams, timelines, budgets, and delivery dependencies to propose practical solutions.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve governance, and enhance delivery effectiveness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, and operational complexity.
* Bring a solution\-led mindset to challenges rather than escalating issues without clear recommendations.
* Produce clear, insightful, and well\-structured communication for both clients and internal leadership.



**People \& Leadership** 



* Act as a dependable leadership presence across assigned teams, providing clear direction, guidance, and support.
* Support Account Management and cross\-functional teams in navigating complex operational scenarios.
* Foster strong collaboration across markets, departments, and hub teams.
* Build trust and credibility with teams through practical leadership, responsiveness, and ownership.
* Coach junior and mid\-level team members on ways of working, project management discipline, and stakeholder management.
* Create clarity in moments of ambiguity and support teams in resolving challenges effectively.
* Encourage collaborative, integrated, and solutions\-oriented team culture aligned with the POUL operating model.
* Demonstrate strong judgement, maturity, and professionalism in both internal and external stakeholder interactions.



**Self** 



* Demonstrate agility and flexibility in responding to evolving business priorities and complex project demands.
* Take ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Operate with resilience and composure under pressure.
* Show strong initiative in anticipating risks, solving problems, and driving improvements.
* Demonstrate learning agility and openness to evolving ways of working.
* Maintain high standards of professionalism, collaboration, and commercial responsibility.
* Act with integrity, sound judgement, and strong accountability in all stakeholder interactions.



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in integrated agency / communications / marketing delivery roles.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-market, cross\-functional workstreams.
* Strong understanding of creative development, production workflows, regional to local operations, finance know\-how, process optimisation \& change management.
* Experience in financial operations, billing governance, and commercial delivery management.
* **Prior experience working across India and/or ASEAN markets is strongly preferred.**
* **Candidates with direct market experience from India or ASEAN, or demonstrated experience managing these regions, will be strongly preferred given the nature of the role.**
* Experience working across matrixed regional / global organisations preferred.
* FMCG / Beauty experience is an advantage.
* Fluency in English.

**Role Overview/Purpose**
 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology, ensuring organizational readiness, optimal resource allocation, and execution of commercial infrastructure (including CRM and analytics). The incumbent will also serve as support to the Global Head in governance, decision\-making, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

**Overall Job Responsibilities**
* Launch Excellence \& Early Access Strategy
* Lead the development and execution of launch strategies for oncology assets in small\-to\-mid\-sized markets.
* Design scalable, repeatable “go\-to\-market” models tailored for distributor\-led or hybrid markets.
* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.
* Build market entry playbooks (partner vs. direct vs. hybrid models).
* Support distributor selection, onboarding, and performance management.
* Ensure alignment of local execution with global brand strategy.

data.jd_text:
A high\-growth, multi\-asset trading group is hiring a Head of Product \& PMO to lead the performance of its trading ecosystem and the execution of strategic initiatives across global operations. The business runs two regulated trading platforms covering FX, CFDs and equities on one side, and crypto spot, perpetual futures, margin and copy trading on the other, serving retail, high\-net\-worth and institutional clients across multiple jurisdictions.
 



  





 This is a dual mandate sitting at the intersection of commercial product leadership and disciplined programme delivery. You will own the product P\&L across crypto and traditional asset classes, shape monetisation strategy, and stand up the PMO function that governs how initiatives are planned, prioritised and delivered across the group.
 



  





**What you will lead** 



* Product strategy and monetisation across all trading products, with continuous refinement based on performance data, competitor moves and market dynamics.
* Full product P\&L ownership across crypto and traditional offerings, driving revenue growth, profitability and unit economics across every product line.
* Establishment and leadership of the PMO function, including governance frameworks, standardised processes, reporting and delivery tracking across all strategic initiatives.
* User acquisition, activation, retention and lifetime value strategy, with constant optimisation of user journeys, trading activity and product stickiness.
* Pricing architecture across trading fees, spreads and liquidity incentive structures, balancing competitiveness with revenue optimisation.
* Data\-driven experimentation and delivery measurement, with structured frameworks for both product and programme outcomes.
* Cross\-functional alignment across Trading, Technology, Marketing, Sales and Operations, ensuring the PMO drives genuine coordination rather than reporting overhead.
* Global expansion and regional product adaptation, maintaining global consistency while tuning for local market fit.
* Leadership and scaling of both the Product and PMO teams, with clear KPIs, accountability and a high\-performance culture.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 8 to 12\+ years in product management and/or programme management, ideally within crypto, trading, FinTech or financial services. Proven track record of owning product P\&L and delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives. Strong understanding of trading platforms, market structures and monetisation. Experience establishing or running PMO functions and delivery frameworks. Data\-driven analytical mindset. Track record of leading high\-performing product and project teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments.
* Preferred: exposure across both crypto and traditional financial products, deep understanding of trading behaviour, liquidity and execution dynamics, multi\-market product and delivery experience, and fluency with Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery methodologies.



  





**Location** 




 Dubai, onsite. Relocation supported
 








**PACKAGE** 




**Base salary in the region of USD 120,000 to 130,000 per annum, paid in AED. Performance\-related annual bonus. ESOP participation. Standard UAE benefits**

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
   

  

 Moove’s growth has been fuelled by its global Uber partnership and support of leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, MUFG, and many others. With operations now spanning 19 cities across 6 continents \- Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and the Middle East \- Moove continues to expand its offerings through strategic acquisitions and partnerships with industry leaders, including Waymo and Uber. Moove is transforming mobility to make it safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while providing economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Performance \& Strategy at Moove is responsible for driving business performance, planning discipline, and execution across markets. This role owns the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including running business reviews, leading planning processes, and identifying and driving resolution of key performance issues in partnership with market and functional leaders. In parallel, you will act as a strategic partner to local teams, supporting critical decisions on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion, while aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. The role also leads key strategic initiatives, including new market launches, new business lines (e.g. AV), and other growth opportunities, ensuring disciplined execution from planning through implementation.
   

  

**This role is a "temp role" of 6 months.**
**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As Moove scales across markets, this role ensures consistent delivery across four core areas: business performance, project management across centrally driven initiatives, expansion, and cross\-functional execution.
   

  

 Critical outcomes (6–12 months)
   

  

* Establish a consistent performance management cadence across markets (SteerCos, dashboards, planning cycles)
* Identify and address key drivers of underperformance, improving profitability and operational efficiency
* Deliver high\-impact strategic initiatives (e.g., market launches, pricing improvements, new revenue streams)


 Scope of responsibilities \& impact areas
   

  

* Performance Management: Own weekly and monthly business reviews, track key metrics, and lead deep dives to understand performance drivers and gaps
* Strategic Planning: Lead annual budgeting, OKRs, and quarterly planning processes, ensuring alignment between company goals and market execution
* Market Support: Provide hands\-on support to local teams on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion decisions through structured analysis
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Finance, Legal, Tech, and Operations to resolve issues and ensure delivery of key priorities
* Data \& Reporting: Partner with Data/BI teams to build and maintain accurate, automated dashboards, ensuring a single source of truth and reducing manual reporting
* Central Program Management: Track and manage key strategic commitments, ensuring accountability and timely execution across teams
* Expansion \& Growth: Support and lead new market launches, new categories, and other strategic initiatives from evaluation through implementation


**What You Will Need For This Position**
 Experience:
   

  

* 10\-12\+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles in high\-growth environments
* Strong track record of driving business performance and solving complex operational problems
* Experience working across multiple markets or regions is preferred


 Education \& Skills:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and financial modeling
* Familiarity with BI tools
* Solid understanding of unit economics, cost structures, and performance drivers


 Behavioural \& Leadership Traits:
   

  

* Structured problem\-solver with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage stakeholders and influence decisions across teams
* Clear and effective communicator, including with senior leadership
* High ownership and ability to operate in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments
* Focus on execution and delivering measurable outcomes


**Key Metrics**
**I** 
 mprovement in core business metrics such as revenue growth, utilization, contribution margin, and cashflow
   

  

* Effectiveness of performance management processes (e.g., quality and consistency of reviews, dashboard adoption)
* Successful delivery of strategic initiatives, including market launches and new revenue streams


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CEO Moove, and closely working with our Central OperationsTeam.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

data.jd_text:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
   

  

* Support coordination across multiple teams or workstreams contributing to Gray Space UL deliverables.
* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an accredited institution.


**Skills**
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting data centers, power systems, electrical infrastructure, or regulated product development preferred.
* Familiarity with UL certification processes or safety‑critical product development.
* Experience operating within large, global enterprises.


**What We Offer You**
* Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry
* Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system
* Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide
* Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally
* Strong processes and state\-of\-the\-art systems and tools
* Detailed induction support and well\-structured onboarding
* Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model


 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

*Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly qualified and experienced Senior Project Manager with a strong technical background in infrastructure and/or master planning to lead and oversee complex Land Development projects within our organisation. The role will have a focus on KSA projects, either based in KSA or in UAE with a requirement for periodic travel to KSA to meet project requirements.
   

  

 The successful candidate will have extensive project management experience as well as a strong technical understanding in Land Development disciplines (master planning, infrastructure, transport planning, landscaping, sustainability). The ideal candidate will possess Middle East experience with the knowledge, skills and expertise to lead multi\-disciplinary land development teams and drive internationally significant Land development projects from inception to completion.

* Client Interaction – Cultivate and maintain strong client relationships, understand their needs and ensure project deliverables meet or exceed client expectations whilst aligning with project budgets
* Cost and Resource Management \- Develop project budgets, monitor and control expenditures, and allocate resources efficiently to optimise project outcomes
* Risk Management \- Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure project success
* Scope and Schedule Management \- Develop a work breakdown structure for the project, create schedules, monitor and control project progress against schedule. Ensure communication is efficiently and accurately flowing into and out of the project, in accordance with business protocols. Evaluate stakeholder power and influence and ensure relevant feedback is considered and requisite approvals sought


**Qualifications**
* Proven project management experience on large and complex Land Development projects in the Middle East

data.jd_text:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
   

  

* Support coordination across multiple teams or workstreams contributing to Gray Space UL deliverables.
* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an accredited institution.


**Skills**
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting data centers, power systems, electrical infrastructure, or regulated product development preferred.
* Familiarity with UL certification processes or safety‑critical product development.
* Experience operating within large, global enterprises.


**What We Offer You**
* Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry
* Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system
* Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide
* Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally
* Strong processes and state\-of\-the\-art systems and tools
* Detailed induction support and well\-structured onboarding
* Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model


 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

*Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*
**Living and Working in Dubai**
*Dubai is a vibrant, cosmopolitan city known for its modern architecture, luxurious lifestyle, and rich cultural heritage. Living and working in Dubai offers an exceptional quality of life with world\-class amenities, a safe environment, and a thriving expatriate community. Experience a dynamic blend of work and leisure in one of the world’s most exciting cities.
   

  

 Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*

 We are seeking a dynamic, client\-focused, and detail\-oriented ERP Project Manager with strong implementation experience to lead end\-to\-end ERP deployments. The role requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills and a strong ability to manage client relationships, commercial performance, and project risks.
 



 As a key liaison between the organization and clients, he/she will ensure timely and successful ERP implementation (with all sign offs and agreements on the delivery), maintain commercial health of projects, identify growth opportunities, and build a solid base for long\-term customer success.

 2\. Communication \& Meeting Governance
 



 • Ensure right, timely, and effective communication with all stakeholders.
 



 • Draft clear, professional emails, documentation, and client communications.
 



 • Schedule and ensure meetings occur with required internal and client stakeholders.
 



 • Proactively communicate the importance of attendance and ensure no critical meeting lapses.
 



 • Prepare for meetings at least one day in advance with:
 



 o Updated project reports
 



 o Draft presentation (PPT)

 • Prepare Minutes of Meeting (MOM) as per company template.
 



 • Circulate draft MOM for review, ensuring internal review time does not exceed 10–a5 minutes.
 



 • Issue final MOM with updated PPT and project reports on the same or next working day.
 



 3\. Action Tracking \& Follow\-Up
 



 • Track and follow up on all internal and external action items.
 



 • Ensure pending points are regularly monitored and resolved.
 



 • Maintain a structured action tracker and ensure accountability from all stakeholders.
 



 4\. Commercial \& Financial Oversight
 



 • Ensure the commercial health of the project.
 



 • Monitor billing milestones, billing, payments, and cost control.
 



 • Identify potential commercial risks and escalate proactively.
 



 • Coordinate with internal finance and client teams to prevent payment delays or contractual issues.

 6\. Client Relationship Management
 



 • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
 



 • Build long\-term, trust\-based client relationships.
 



 • Ensure smooth transition from implementation to support phase.
 



 7\. Sales, Upselling \& Account Growth
 



 • Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities during implementation and post go\-live.
 



 • Coordinate with functional and sales team for solution presentations, proposal development, and commercial discussions.
 



  





  





 Key Requirements
 



 • 5\+ years of experience in ERP implementation as a Project Manager or Account Manager.
 



 • Proven track record in managing full\-cycle ERP implementations through go\-live and transition to support.
 



 • Strong client\-facing experience with excellent stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Experience managing commercial aspects of projects including billing, scope control, and financial performance.
