data.jd_text:
**It's more than a job**
 In an administrative role at Kuehne\+Nagel, tasks such as managing office operations or coordinating schedules certainly contribute to your team's success, but they also provide meaningful moments for people around the world. Because your attention to detail supports your colleagues to perform at their best, such as ensuring the timely and seamless transport of hearing aids and advanced medical devices that change lives. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our work contributes to more than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 Energy Business Development Manager role is one of the most critical commercial positions supporting our Project Logistics strategy. The EBDM reports directly to the Global Head of Project Logistics Energy.No team reports into this position; it is an individual contributor role with significant strategic impact.
   

  

 The EBDM is responsible for generating new business opportunities across all segments of the Oil \& Gas value chain, developing a strong pipeline within defined markets, and analysing market potential and competitive dynamics to prioritize opportunities aligned with strategic goals.
   

  

 Working closely with global and regional stakeholders, the Energy Business Development Manager builds customer relationships based on trust, expertise, and innovation, ensuring the right internal and external partners are engaged at the right time to secure new projects.
   

  

 This role requires a professional who exemplifies strong Compliance and HSE standards, demonstrates strategic thinking, and thrives in a customer‑centric, high‑impact environment.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* Identify new business opportunities and coordinate cross‑functional teams to develop these into firm project awards.
* Lead and manage global tenders and bids for major potential customers, securing required approvals from relevant stakeholders, including the IPMT.
* Monitor the business pipeline and success ratios, taking corrective actions together with the Global Head of Project Logistics Business Development when needed.
* Maintain regular communication with key internal stakeholders (Global/National Project Logistics Teams, Tender Management, etc.) and provide updates to senior leadership upon request.
* Demonstrate self\-driven, motivational leadership by communicating clear goals, securing stakeholder buy‑in, and aligning activities with strategic direction.
* Record all opportunities in Corelog and act as a role model for Compliance and HSE standards.
* Foster strong collaboration across Project Logistics Development functions, Operations, Technology, and both Geographic and Technical Leadership teams.
* Drive Gross Profit growth by identifying and securing profitable business opportunities aligned with the Project Logistics Roadmap and strategic objectives.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders, develop business and account plans, and pursue opportunities in alignment with (Key) Account Owners or independently where appropriate.


**What we would like you to bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Proven experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Commercial roles within Energy, Oil \& Gas, EPC, or Project Logistics.
* Strong understanding of the Oil \& Gas value chain and major project cycles, including tendering and contract negotiation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex global bids and manage senior‑level customer engagements.
* Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, with the ability to assess markets, build business plans, and prioritize opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across global and matrixed organizations.
* High level of self‑motivation and ownership, with a strong commitment to Compliance and HSE standards; proficiency in CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.


**What's in it for you**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact within Kuehne\+Nagel by shaping major Energy and Project Logistics developments, working in an international and collaborative environment, gaining visibility with global leadership, and benefiting from a culture that values ownership, innovation, and professional growth.
   

  

**Who are we**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.
   

  

 We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

data.jd_text:
一、岗位职责
 



 1\. 交易系统基础设施与稳定性保障
 



 \- 负责公司核心交易系统（现货/合约/衍生品/撮合引擎）的整体运维架构与稳定性保障
 



 \- 建立7x24小时高可用运维体系，确保交易系统低延迟、高吞吐与零宕机目标
 



 \- 设计并优化多活/容灾/异地双活架构，保障极端行情下系统稳定运行
 



 2\. 高并发与低延迟架构支持
 



 \- 支撑高频交易与极端行情流量洪峰（行情波动、插针行情、黑天鹅事件等）
 



 \- 优化网络链路、撮合系统、行情系统及API网关性能
 



 \- 持续降低系统延迟（Latency Optimization）与提升系统吞吐能力
 



 3\. 云基础设施与全球化部署
 



 \- 负责全球多机房、多地域云资源架构设计与统一管理（AWS / GCP / 阿里云等）
 



 \- 推动全球节点部署（亚太、欧美等）与跨境网络优化
 



 \- 优化云资源成本结构与资源利用率
 



 4\. 运维体系与自动化建设（SRE/DevOps）
 



 \- 建设标准化SRE体系，包括监控、告警、发布、变更、回滚机制
 



 \- 推动全链路自动化运维（CI/CD、自动扩缩容、自动故障自愈）
 



 \- 建设统一监控体系（Metrics/Logs/Tracing）与AIOps能力
 



 5\. 安全与风控支撑
 



 \- 建立基础设施安全体系（权限管理、访问控制、漏洞管理、DDoS防护）
 



 \- 配合安全团队构建交易安全与资金安全防护体系
 



 \- 支撑风控系统稳定运行（异常交易监控、风险引擎稳定性保障）
 



 6\. 重大故障与应急管理
 



 \- 负责重大线上事故的应急响应、根因分析（RCA）及复盘机制
 



 \- 建立事故分级响应机制（P0/P1/P2）及演练体系
 



 \- 提升整体MTTR（平均恢复时间）与系统可用性指标
 



 7\. 团队管理与组织建设
 



 \- 管理SRE/系统/网络/安全/DBA等运维团队
 



 \- 建立技术梯队与绩效体系，提升团队工程能力
 



 \- 支撑公司全球化业务扩展与组织规模增长
 



 8\. 跨部门协同
 



 \- 与研发、产品、交易系统、风控、安全等团队紧密协作
 



 \- 支撑交易系统快速迭代与业务上线节奏
 



 \- 参与关键技术架构评审与系统设计决策
 



 二、任职要求
 



 1\. 经验背景
 



 \- 本科及以上学历，计算机、网络、通信等相关专业优先
 



 \- 8年以上运维/基础架构/SRE经验，其中至少3年以上团队管理经验
 



 \- 有交易所 / 数字货币 / 金融交易系统 / 高并发系统经验优先
 



 2\. 核心技术能力
 



 \- 熟悉Linux系统、网络架构（TCP/IP、BGP、CDN等）
 



 \- 熟悉分布式系统架构、微服务架构及中间件（Kafka/Redis/MySQL等）
 



 \- 熟悉云平台（AWS/GCP/AliCloud）及Kubernetes容器化体系
 



 \- 具备大型系统性能调优与故障排查能力
 



 3\. 行业能力（关键）
 



 \- 理解交易系统架构（撮合引擎、订单系统、行情系统、钱包系统）
 



 \- 熟悉高频交易、低延迟系统设计优先
 



 \- 有应对极端行情（暴涨暴跌）系统稳定性经验
 



 4\. 管理能力
 



 \- 能管理50人以上运维团队
 



 \- 有较强跨部门推动能力（研发/产品/风控/安全）
 



 \- 能建立制度化、流程化运维体系
 



 5\. 软性要求
 



 \- 极强抗压能力（7x24事故响应场景）
 



 \- 结果导向，逻辑清晰，决策能力强
 



 \- 能适应全球化业务节奏与时区协作
 



 三、加分项
 



 \- 有交易所或Web3基础设施经验
 



 \- 有撮合系统/高频交易系统运维经验
 



 \- 有0→1搭建SRE体系经验
 


* \- 有多活容灾/全球节点架构经验

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
   

  

 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
   

  

 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.


**What You Will Need For This Position**
* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.


**Key Metrics**
* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

data.jd_text:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off meeting
* Ensure preparation of detailed project schedule with appropriate milestones, based on contract.
* Ensure that drawings are obtained from design team. Review and approve drawings prior to submission to client and monitor and review all rework and resubmissions until final approval is obtained.
* Work with Finance and Management team to prepare ACE and get it approved.
* Define initial organization of project team, competencies required based on contract and project scope and work with HR to hire members for key positions immediately. Define detailed org chart subsequently and take steps to build an effective team with required skill set and mobilize the team.
* Evaluate available sub\-contractor options and get quote from suitable ones and submit to management. Participate in a meeting with other committee members ( BU Head, regional head, finance head etc) to finalize sub\-contractor.
* Ensure resource mobilization for the project at various stages, as required.
* Ensure that soil testing and initial site assessments are completed properly as per schedule.
* Ensure that procurement is on track and provide necessary support for the same.
* Review and finalize Project Quality Manual (PQM) and Health and safety Manual ( HSM)
* Establish relationship with all stakeholders including the client and CE and internal stakeholders including management team, supporting teams.


**Project Execution And Completion**
* Ensure resource deployment and mobilization as per project strategy and project requirements.
* Ensure material procurement and logistics are on track and site is ready to receive materials as per delivery schedule.
* Set up efficient systems and processes to ensure smooth interactions between various departments.
* Monitor and keep abreast of all site activities and ensure that all issues and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
* Monitor progress periodically against schedule, quality standards and budget (ACE), as well as against contractual requirements, client requirements and company standards. Highlight critical points and propose corrective action plans.
* Ensure adherence of every function and process to PQM and HSM right through the project lifecycle. Monitor NCR and keep a check on LTI.
* Prepare risk assessment and mitigation plans.
* Organize weekly project review meetings with project team, site team and Engineering team (Head Quarter) to understand the design progress, actual project progress in terms of SPI, CPI, EVM etc. and provide appropriate action plans.
* Present project status updates to the management team during management review meetings
* Gather extensive knowledge on local people and communities in order to arrange social awareness programs for site teams.


**Team Management**
* Provide guidance and support to the various project teams to achieve their respective goals.
* Ensure that all teams are communicating with each other appropriately.
* Conduct weekly review meetings with site team.
* Ensure that site team and workmen are motivated and engaged and ensure that all their basic needs are met.
* Ensure that new joiners are inducted and on\-boarded effectively.


**Client/Consultant Management**
* Establish a good working relationship with the client and CE and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Represent the company’s interests while dealing with the client/CE.
* Ensure that progress reports are shared with client/CE as per agreed terms.
* Keep the client informed of any changes/developments/major deviations from contract required during execution and get required approvals.
* Ensure that all client approvals are obtained appropriately and without delay and all client/CE inspections are conducted as per contract. Address any variations contractually.
* Approve all communications to the client, from members of the project team.
* Attend review meetings, along with project \& execution team as required when arranged by client or CE.


**Sub\-contractor Management**
* Ensure mobilization of sub\-contractor’s resources as per project plan
* Ensure development and implementation of sub\-contractor’s work plan and reporting/review mechanism.
* Monitor quality and safety plan implementation by sub\-cotractors


**Reporting**
* Review periodic reports submitted by heads of departments and take necessary actions.
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality, Schedule and Cost related items to BU Head/ Head of operations(SS/TL) as per mutually agreed terms
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality and Schedule related items to Client/CE as per contract.


**Financial**
* Prepare and periodically review project related budgets.
* Monitor and control cost to ensure profitability of project is maintained.
* Ensure that sales targets are achieved and invoicing and collections are done on time.
* Develop strategy for Processing Claims and implement it with all relevant stakeholders including customers, suppliers, partners, insurances and other third parties.


**Statutory**
* Manage contracts effectively with internal and external stakeholders, CE and client.
* Ensure that work adheres to all statutory requirements and policies on safety, environment and community issues as per contract, company policies and law of land.
* Be the front end for bidding for all local legislative and administrative government authorities.


**Role Requirements**
**Education :** 
 BE Electrical
   

  

**Experience**
 Electrical Substation projects:
   

  

* Should have 15 to 20 years’ experience in Electrical/Civil/Mechanical aspects of SS Projects Experience in the project management of medium / large size EPC projects.

**Job Description – Expert, Special Projects** 




**Function:** 
 Strategy and Transformation
 



  





**1\. Role Purpose** 




 The Expert – Special Projects plays a critical role within the Strategy and Transformation function, leading high\-impact, strategic initiatives that are central to the organization’s value creation agenda. These initiatives form a core and sustained part of the Strategy and Transformation function’s mandate and require strong ownership, intellectual leadership, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into practical, high\-value outcomes.
 



 Reporting to the Group Director – Strategy \& Transformation, this role offers the opportunity to work directly on Board\- and leadership\-sponsored initiatives, shaping key decisions and driving measurable impact across the organization. The incumbent is expected to independently structure and solve complex problems, develop robust analytical insights, and lead cross\-functional execution to deliver sustainable business results.
 



 Operating within a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment, the role provides exposure to a collaborative and results\-driven team focused on driving growth, transformation, and enterprise\-wide success.  Initiatives focused on unlocking step\-change value across the business—including revenue growth, market expansion, profitability uplift, and structural cost transformation—through rigorous analysis, zero\-based problem solving, and decisive performance interventions and Board/leadership\-driven strategic deep\-dives.

* Drive end\-to\-end implementation of initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to defined objectives

* Contribute to the development of tools, methodologies, and best practices for managing special projects

**Technical \& Professional Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with ability to structure complex and ambiguous problems

 , or equivalent experience in transformation / strategy functions within large organizations

data.jd_text:
This role is for academic leaders who prefer designing systems over critiquing them. You possess sufficient subject expertise to recognize excellence in learning, the rigor to translate those insights into measurable rubrics and AI\-driven quality mechanisms, and the pragmatism to execute quickly with incomplete data. Student growth matters to you, and you accept accountability for those results.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning pursues what few in software or education dare to attempt. There are no instructors, no conventional textbooks, and no safety net of traditional pedagogy beneath the platform. AI forms the operational foundation. In this capacity, you will leverage it to produce and refine learning materials, architect interventions, oversee quality standards, and advance platform capabilities. The tempo resembles high\-output environments in technology, consulting, or finance more than traditional schooling, and the reward is direct responsibility for subject\-area student performance across multiple sites.
   

  

 This position centers on operating a function. You will construct AI\-enabled learning ecosystem upgrades, act on student performance data through focused interventions, produce evidence\-backed decision documentation, and lead a team measured against explicit benchmarks tied to MAP, AP, SAT, and ISEE outcomes. You will also collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data science teams to shape platform evolution. It suits individuals who instinctively turn to AI, conduct their own analyses, deliver under uncertainty, and accept full ownership of results. It will not suit those who favor consensus\-driven timelines, minimal accountability, or reliance on established methods.
   

  

 You will serve as a central leader within the academics organization, wielding real authority over your subject's performance and the learning system's broader evolution. Your colleagues will depend on your standards, your discernment, and your capacity to convert student data into tangible action. If that prospect excites rather than daunts you, this role was designed with you in mind.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Learning Ecosystem Enhancements — AI\-produced refinements to K–12 subject\-specific learning experiences spanning content, adaptive learning pathways, and student interventions, shaped by student feedback, platform analytics, assessments, and coaching observations.
* Data\-Driven Academic Interventions — Focused intervention strategies for underperforming students or groups, informed by MAP, AP, SAT, ISEE, and comparable performance metrics.
* Student Performance Decision Records — Replicable, evidence\-grounded decisions that document actions taken to improve student outcomes, backed by dashboards, analytics, ticketing systems, surveys, coaching interactions, and assessment results.
* Learning Ecosystem Improvement Specs — Execution\-ready specifications for product, engineering, and data science enhancements, containing problem definitions, supporting data, anticipated student impact, and acceptance criteria.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Wrapping traditional pedagogy in AI packaging. This is not about digitizing classroom teaching – we are reimagining learning fundamentally.
* Conducting data analysis in a vacuum. Regular interaction with K\-12 students is expected, treating their feedback as vital input from our customers.
* Awaiting consensus before taking bold action. You will advocate for an ambitious vision and mobilize others through data\-backed outcomes.
* Adhering to traditional educational practices. You will have freedom to test innovative strategies for motivation, assessment, and instruction.
* Viewing AI as a threat to education. In this role, you will embrace AI as a transformative instrument to advance learning outcomes.


**Director Of Learning Key Responsibilities**
 Lead innovation in AI\-powered, teacher\-less education to achieve outstanding student outcomes across multiple campuses. Integrate data analytics with consistent student interaction to continuously refine our learning ecosystem, measured through AP exam results and MAP assessment growth.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Master's degree or higher in Educational Science, Learning Science, Psychology, Psychometrics, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 5 years of experience in academic or EdTech leadership roles, with direct people management responsibility (hiring, performance evaluation, coaching, termination decisions)
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools as part of day\-to\-day professional workflows, and willingness to rely on AI extensively to improve academic and operational outcomes.
* Strong understanding of learning science principles, such as Cognitive Load Theory and Mayer's Multimedia Principles, and data\-driven educational approaches


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

data.jd_text:
**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.
* Liaise with Ministries of Education and local education councils.
* Develop data\-driven, multi\-year enrollment projection scenarios to establish capacity parameters and budgetary requirements.
* Monitor and assess the growth of the external student sponsorship program and strengthen relationships with sponsoring organizations.
* Represent the university at media events and on\- and off\-campus recruitment functions.
* Develop a recruitment and new\-student communications plan, guiding prospects from initial inquiry through matriculation.
* Develop and implement, in consultation with the recruitment team, an annual comprehensive recruitment campaign plan.
* Co\-manage, with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department, the development of communication plans and the implementation of promotional tools for recruitment campaigns (e.g., social media, advertising).
* Engage colleges/schools, faculty, alumni, and various AUS departments in recruitment efforts to achieve enrollment goals.
* Establish partnership agreements with select high schools locally and internationally to attract highly qualified applicants.
* Lead the integration of automation and artificial intelligence solutions to enhance enrollment operations, improve applicant experience, increase efficiency, and transition key processes from manual to data\-driven digital workflows.


**Qualifications And Skills Required**
* Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of the higher education landscape, including emerging trends, regulatory frameworks, and best practices in enrollment management.
* Solid background in developing and implementing admissions policies, academic credential evaluation standards, and related governance frameworks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.


**How To Apply**
* Interested applicants should fill out the form.
* AUS alumni are encouraged to apply. Applicants who do not meet specified requirements will not be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
* AUS is an equal opportunity employer. We adhere to a policy of making employment decisions without regard to race, color, age, gender, religion, national origin, disability or marital status. Opportunities for employment are based solely upon one’s qualifications.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Due to a restructure focused around enhancing the quality of our coaching programme,
 **Hamilton Aquatics** 
 is looking for an experienced and dynamic individual to take on the role of
 **Director of Swimming** 
 . The purpose of the role is to lead the design, development, and delivery of our entire swimming pathway. This role oversees both Learn to Swim and Squad programmes (with a heavy focus on the squad programme), ensuring a high\-quality, aligned, and sustainable structure that supports our swimmers from entry level through to elite performance.
   

  

 The Director will lead programme standards, coaching quality, competition structures, and athlete development systems across all sites. This role is critical in delivering long\-term athlete development, competitive success, and an outstanding member experience. While not responsible for a specific squad, the Director of Swimming will regularly be on poolside to mentor coaches and provide coaching cover when required.
   

  

**Key Objectives**
* Deliver a world\-class, fully integrated swimming pathway from Learn to Swim through to Elite Performance
* Ensure consistent programme structure, coaching standards, and delivery quality across all sites through the use of Technical Swimming Committee and the Hamilton Way Philosophy
* Perform site visits to mentor and support the development of coaches and swimmers
* Attendance at competitions
* Lead and develop a high\-performing coaching team through effective leadership and CPD
* Drive performance outcomes through direct coaching and performance oversight
* Strengthen the link between the pathways
* Enhance swimmer retention, progression, and experience across all programmes
* Maintain strong operational alignment with business objectives and growth plans
* Line management of direct reports


**Desired Qualifications**
**Set of Required Skills, Knowledge and Behaviours**
* Club Coach or Swim England Level 3 Coach equivalent or above
* Relevant High Performance or Leadership qualifications desirable


**Desired Experience**
* 8 plus years coaching experience, including elite level swimmers
* 5 plus years in a senior leadership or programme management role
* Proven experience managing large scale swim programmes and multi site operations
* Demonstrated success in developing swimmers through to high performance level


**Job\-Specific Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong understanding of Long\-Term Athlete Development models
* Expertise in programme design, periodisation, and competition planning
* Excellent leadership, communication, and people management skills
* Excellent time management skills
* Ability to manage and influence large teams, problem solving and conflict resolution
* Strong stakeholder management across parents, schools, and governing bodies
* Analytical mindset with experience using performance tracking systems
* High level of organisation and operational awareness


**What We Offer**
* A competitive salary package
* Annual flight allowance
* Private medical insurance
* End of service benefit
* Access to lifestyle discounts

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an accomplished Director – Major Projects \& Infrastructure to lead the strategic planning and delivery of major transport and infrastructure design programmes across the Middle East. This senior leadership role is responsible for portfolio performance, client engagement, operational oversight, and technical governance across complex multi\-disciplinary projects, ensuring high\-quality delivery, strong commercial outcomes, and trusted relationships with key government and private\-sector stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring proven experience leading large\-scale highways, transport, and integrated infrastructure programmes, with the credibility to operate at executive level across clients, authorities, delivery teams, and business leadership.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Provide strategic leadership for a portfolio of major transport and infrastructure programmes, aligning delivery priorities with business objectives, client needs, and regional market opportunities.
* Shape market positioning and support business growth through key account development, pursuit strategy, proposal leadership, and executive\-level client engagement.
* Establish clear governance, decision\-making frameworks, and performance expectations across programmes to support consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Represent the business externally with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders, strengthening market profile and helping secure future opportunities.
* Work closely with peers and the broader leadership team in an effective and collaborative manner.


**Project \& Programme Management**
* Lead the delivery of major transport and infrastructure projects from concept through detailed design and construction support, ensuring programmes are structured, resourced, and governed effectively.
* Own programme performance against schedule, budget, margin, cash flow, and quality targets, with clear accountability for forecasting, financial control, and overall portfolio health.
* Drive programme controls including risk management, change control, reporting, KPI monitoring, schedule assurance, and recovery planning across multi\-package and multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Oversee resource planning and coordination across multi\-disciplinary teams to maintain delivery efficiency and effective interface management.


**Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, government authorities, and strategic partners across the region, including ministries, commissions, municipalities, and major development entities.
* Act as the senior client interface for major programmes, leading executive discussions, resolving complex issues, and maintaining confidence in delivery performance and commercial outcomes.
* Oversee stakeholder coordination and authority engagement, including support for approvals, permitting, and resolution of issues affecting programme progress.


**Technical Excellence**
* Provide technical leadership across engineering solutions, mobility strategies, and design methodologies, ensuring that projects are innovative, practical, and aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure robust technical assurance and compliance with international standards, local authority requirements, design safety obligations, and organisational quality systems.
* Champion digital engineering, BIM, model\-based delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and consistency across programmes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire high\-performing multi\-disciplinary teams, setting clear expectations for delivery, collaboration, and professional standards.
* Build organisational capability through effective resource planning, performance management, knowledge sharing, and development of specialist and leadership talent.
* Support recruitment, succession planning, and retention strategies to strengthen long\-term capability across the transport and infrastructure business.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 20\+ years of experience delivering major transport and infrastructure projects, with at least 10 years in the Middle East.
* Proven leadership experience on mega‑projects such as highways programmes, mobility corridors, rail/metro interfaces, smart mobility projects, and integrated infrastructure developments.
* Strong background in multi‑disciplinary design management, including roads, highways, bridges and utilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large consultant and contractor teams within complex programme environments, with strong capability in resource planning, delivery oversight, and interface management.
* Excellent knowledge of international and regional codes, design standards, and approval processes.
* Sound understanding of design safety, HSE leadership, regulatory compliance, and authority approvals processes across major infrastructure programmes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client‑facing skills with experience engaging with ministries and major authorities.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status (CEng, PE, PEng, etc.) is highly desirable.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 This role is for someone who wants real ownership.
   

  

 You’ll be the right hand to the Network Health and Trust \& Safety leadership, owning complex, high\-impact programs that protect customers, partners, and the business. This is not a reporting or coordination role. You will identify risks before they escalate, turn ambiguity into clear execution plans, and drive programs that balance safety, compliance, and operational reality.
   

  

 You’ll work across teams that don’t naturally align, often without direct authority. Your job is to connect the dots, make hard calls, and ensure the right things get done on time, at scale, and with measurable impact.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving messy problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and building mechanisms that last, this role will stretch you in the best way.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Trust \& Safety and Network Health programs from problem definition to execution and sustained outcomes
* Identify systemic risks and compliance gaps; design scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Drive execution across multiple teams with competing priorities
* Set clear goals, milestones, and success metrics for complex initiatives
* Act as a thought partner to senior leadership on risk, safety, and long\-term strategy
* Build simple, durable mechanisms to track progress and enforce standards
* Raise the bar on how programs are designed, reviewed, and communicated


 A day in the life
   

  

**On a Typical Day, You Might**
* Deep dive into data to understand where risks are emerging and why
* Align with product, operations, legal, and analytics partners on priorities and trade\-offs
* Challenge unclear plans and push for sharper problem statements and success metrics
* Review program progress, unblock teams, and escalate when needed
* Translate complex issues into clear updates for senior stakeholders
* Improve existing processes so teams spend less time reacting and more time preventing issues


 Your internal stakeholders include operations leaders, product teams, analytics partners, and legal or policy counterparts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Network Health (NH) and Trust \& Safety (T\&S) teams work together to protect Amazon’s Last Mile operations by driving compliance, partner accountability, and safety across the AMET region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey).
   

  

 Network Health owns the end\-to\-end compliance and enforcement lifecycle for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) — from risk identification and MEP (Monitoring \& Enforcement Plan) management to exit governance and performance reviews. The team ensures that all DSPs operate safely, ethically, and in alignment with Amazon’s Supply Chain Standards and local labor regulations.
   

  

 Trust \& Safety complements this work by focusing on driver\-level safety, identity verification, and incident resolution programs such as ID Check, APEA, and DAF, ensuring that both DSPs and drivers uphold Amazon’s zero\-tolerance standards on compliance and worker welfare.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of both functions, helping deliver secure, compliant, and sustainable operations in one of Amazon’s fastest\-growing regions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- Amazon Middle East and North Africa FZ\-LLC

data.jd_text:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in technical program management, with a focus on infrastructure projects.
* 5 years of experience in a leadership role with direct reports.
* Experience in both fiber optic network design/deployment (OSP) and data center infrastructure (ISP).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of multi\-disciplinary experience in network, fiber, electrical, and mechanical (cooling) systems.
* Experience working with global carriers and stakeholders in the EMEA and APAC telecommunications and data center markets.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to navigate through ambiguity and build consensus among high\-level executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record in New Product Initiatives (NPI), specifically in defining standards for deployable infrastructure solutions.


**About The Job**
 Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering\-specific programs and teams.
   

  

 The Fiber Infrastructure Engineering and Delivery team is a unified organization within Google Global Infrastructure, integrating the expertise of capacity infrastructure engineering, network infrastructure engineering, and fiber and capacity delivery. Our mission is to deliver the resilient long\-haul and metro fiber assets and data center network space that power Google's global growth and AI leadership. We operate at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and global scale, ensuring Google’s network infrastructure is the most reliable and efficient on the planet.
   

  

 This role requires approximately 25% travel, mostly to Google’s data centers around the globe.
   

  

 Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Orchestrate program strategy across East EU and MENA to drive consistency and economies of scale. Be able to strengthen alignment between technical requirements and business objectives by providing advanced insights facilitating executive decision\-making.
* Define requirements for the Google Global Network, designing data center infrastructure (space, power, cooling) and define new product deployment globally.
* Manage complex relationships globally. Influence and collaborate with design engineering firms, carriers, internal engineering teams, and senior executives to solve large\-scale network growth challenges.
* Establish systems to identify and implement innovative solutions that optimize project delivery. Manage risks and drive improvements in lead\-time, predictability, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Lead a global team of technical program managers. Foster growth mindset and culture of learning, ensuring the team's skills are transferable across technical domains.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.jd_text:
You've shaped a clear academic vision in the past and taken full ownership of the results. You've led visibly, not from the sidelines. And when it comes to learning science, you're not experimenting—you've built something tangible, delivered measurable outcomes, and earned the credibility to share that story publicly. If this describes you, 2 Hour Learning is seeking its academic leader.
   

  

 At 2 Hour Learning, we've developed a model that enables students to learn twice as fast in only two hours each day. AI\-driven tutoring, mastery\-based progression, and a fundamental shift away from traditional classroom structures produce these outcomes. The performance is exceptional. Now we need a leader who can align execution across varied school models, elevate academic leadership standards, and serve as the public voice of a movement rooted in rigorous learning science.
   

  

 This is not a role for academic theory. It's a leadership responsibility. You'll own the practical academic strategy, establish clear standards, surface execution gaps, and coach high\-performing teams to deliver tangible results. You'll translate our scientific principles into operational rigor and advocate for this model on a global stage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Designing academic frameworks that convert learning science into actionable guidance for curriculum design, motivational systems, and application development.
* Conducting academic execution reviews with Heads of Academics to ensure school teams remain aligned, accountable, and results\-driven.
* Integrating data, interviews, and direct observation into academic ecosystem evaluations that identify the highest\-impact obstacles to accelerated learning and recommend concrete interventions.
* Ensuring strategic alignment through planning processes, feedback mechanisms, and milestone monitoring to sustain focus on student learning objectives.
* Serving as the external face of 2 Hour Learning at the highest levels, from keynote presentations to engagements with Ministries of Education, advancing systemic change in global education thinking.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Working on isolated curriculum initiatives that fail to create systemic impact.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from student outcomes or practical execution.
* Passing performance accountability to middle managers or external consultants.
* Depending on brand reputation or theory to convince skeptical stakeholders.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and refine 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by aligning execution across schools, raising leadership standards, and serving as the public advocate for a movement built on rigorous science and proven results.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




  





 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Real Estate \& Hospitality banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 




  




* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
* Demonstrate understanding of the sector across all RE asset classes

* Cross collaborate to obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals to expand RE market share
* Anchor Strategic Alliances with UAE’s Top Developers, Authorities, and sector experts

* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
* Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks and attend industry events to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Business Origination** 




**Client Relationship Management** 




  




* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Establish appropriate monitoring of client relationships and the underlying RE portfolio performance
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 




  




* Align with the relevant Real Estate teams across the bank (credit, products) as well as other partners (international FAB offices) to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 




  




* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Real Estate \& Hospitality group and Real Estate team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short \& long term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.



  





**Qualifications**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.



  





**Experience**




  





 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.
 



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes**




  




* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
* Demonstrable RE Sector knowledge and experience.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyse and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

 We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 We are seeking an Associate Director of Business Development and Capture Management to join our organization in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. **Talent Developer**

 Delivers results and leads others to do the same; effectively managing risk to lead through change and ambiguity advancing AECOM’s vision, purpose and strategies.

**Industry Standout**

 When representing AECOM externally:
   

* Is recognized by clients as a leader within AECOM able to drive change.
* Has in depth market and technical knowledge.
* Demonstrates an external presence in the market.
* May be an active participant in industry groups
  


 When representing AECOM internally:
   

* Demonstrates the ability to influence leadership to ensure bid opportunities are prioritized.
* Works with Regional Business Line and Market Sector Leaders to identify new business opportunities and propose solutions to address them
  


 When inspiring innovation:
   

* Identifies long\-term and disruptive trends in their area of expertise.
* Drives client adoption of key AECOM initiatives such as ESG and digitalization.
* Partners with clients to respond to their innovation agenda.
  


**Client Builder**
  

 Has a deep understanding of client priorities and is client\-focused, connects team to their vision, ensuring they provide the best AECOM experience every time.
   

  

 When building client/stakeholder relationships:
   

* Is AECOM’s pursuit lead for ECPs.
* Has developed strong relationships with critical stakeholders.
* Able to build consensus to change client expectations in challenging situations.
  


 When building AECOM’s reputation:
   

* Champions for ethical and safe working practices.
* Integrates AECOM and client values to positively impact AECOM’s wider reputation.
* Demonstrates strong leadership attributes that provide role modelling for others
  


 When executing our growth strategy:
   

* Drives growth in potential project pipeline.
* Leads the capture of significant new business opportunities and the renewal/extension of existing large\-scale agreements.
* Has a relationship with key client suppliers and partner organizations.
* Liaises with Market Sector and Regional teams to identify growth opportunities..
  


 When focused on our commercial business:
   

* Demonstrates strong commercial acumen.
* Collaborates across Regions and business lines to build consensus on commercial terms.
  


**Qualifications**
* 15 \+ years of progressive business development experience, with at least 8 years in a leadership or management capacity
* Proven expertise in capture management and proposal development for complex, enterprise\-level opportunities
* Demonstrated success in building and managing high\-performing teams
* Strong understanding of sales methodologies, pipeline management, and forecasting
* Excellent strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to assess market opportunities
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Proficiency with CRM systems and business development tools
* Experience managing P\&L and driving revenue growth
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Experience in government technology sectors
* Knowledge of Middle East market dynamics and business practices
* Familiarity with bid management software and proposal automation tools
* Track record of successfully closing large, complex deals
* Experience with strategic account management and customer relationship development
  


**Additional Information**
  

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* 
***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.
