**About us**




  





 Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




  





 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the corporate banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the team’s day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 




  





 • Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
 



 Business Origination
 



 • Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
 



 • Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
 



 • Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.
 



 • Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
 



 • Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals.
 



 • Anchor Strategic Alliances with UAE’s Top Developers \& Authorities
 



 • Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions
 



 • Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields
 



 • Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
 



 • Bank's management.
 



 • Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
 



 • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate business.
 



 • Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
 



 • Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
 



 • Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.
 



  





**Client Relationship Management** 




  





 • To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
 



 • Prepare and Maintain Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
 



 • Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
 



 • Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
 



 • Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
 



 • Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
 



 • Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
 



 • Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
 



 • Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
 



 • Onboard new clients as and when required.
 



  





**Collaboration** 




  





 • Align with Corporate team as well as other partners to identify and convert opportunities.
 



 • Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
 



 • Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
 



 • Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).
 



  





**Operational** 




  





 • Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
 



 • Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
 



 • Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
 



 • Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
 



 • Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
 



 • Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
 



 • Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
 



 • Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
 



 • Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
 



 • Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.
 



  





**Leadership** 




  





 • Act as Role Model for the entire Corporate Banking group and team
 



 • Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short \& long term successors
 



 • Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
 



 • Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
 



 • Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
 



 • Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
 



 • Involvement in team members new hirings.
 



  





**Qualifications**




  





**Minimum Qualification** 




  





 • Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
 



 • Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.
 



  





**Minimum Experience** 




 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.
 



  





**Knowledge, Skills, and Attributes:** 




  





 • Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
 



 • Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
 



 • Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
 



 • Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
 



 • Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
 



 • Ability to analyse and research information.
 



 • Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
 



 • Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
 



 • Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
 



 • Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

**Job Description**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About the MENAP Team**
 The MENAP Group sits within Canva’s International Supergroup and is responsible for growing Canva’s presence across the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan. We work across sales, partnerships, community, and growth — combining deep regional market knowledge with Canva’s global platform to bring great design tools to more people in more places.
   

  

 Education is a key strategic investment for the MENAP team. We’re building something significant here, and we’re doing it now when the decisions about how to grow in education will shape the region for years to come.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Education Growth Lead for MENAP, you’ll own the strategy and execution for how Canva activates and grows within schools and universities across the region. This isn’t a sales role. Your focus is what happens after: ensuring that the institutions Canva enters genuinely embed it, use it, and expand their adoption on it over time.
   

  

 You’ll build the relationships with education ministries, school networks, and university bodies that create institutional\-level traction. You’ll design and deliver programs, like University Champions and Canva for Campus, that turn early access into active, sticky usage. And you’ll work cross\-functionally with EDU product management, product marketing, engineering, and analytics to make sure the platform and GTM motion are actually working for education users in this region.
   

  

 While the initial focus is GCC, you’re building the playbook for all of MENAP. The patterns you establish here will influence how Canva approaches education growth across the broader region for years to come.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop and own the MENAP Education Growth strategy across school leadership and university sectors, starting with GCC and expanding across the broader MENAP region.
* Build and sustain partnerships with education ministries, school networks, regional education authorities, university bodies, and student organisations — including crafting formal MoUs and government partnership agreements.
* Design and deliver GTM strategies for flagship education programs including University Champions and Canva for Campus, from concept through to in\-market execution.
* Coordinate cross\-functional work with EDU product managers, product marketing, engineering, and analytics teams to ensure the product and GTM motion reflect the needs of MENAP education users.
* Collaborate with MENAP Sales and Community teams to share insights from schools and universities, align on event presence and messaging, and drive adoption at scale through complementary outreach.
* Represent Canva at regional education events, conferences, and partner briefings, building Canva’s profile as a leading education technology partner in MENAP.
* Identify and develop strategic partnerships with government education initiatives and digital transformation programmes, including crafting the partnership frameworks and MoUs that underpin them.


**What We're Looking For**
 As a regional lead role, you’re someone who can own a complex, cross\-functional challenge and drive it forward with both strategic clarity and hands\-on execution. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity — education ecosystems in MENAP are diverse, often deeply relationship\-driven, and require patience alongside pace.
   

  

 You likely bring experience in EdTech, policy, higher education, or public sector strategy, and you know how to work within institutional contexts without losing momentum. You’re a strong relationship builder who can hold meaningful conversations with senior education leaders, ministry officials, and student communities alike. You bring sharp program management skills, you can design a GTM motion and actually ship it, and you’re genuinely curious about how education works across different markets and cultures in this region.
   

  

 Critically, you understand what this role is and isn’t. You’re not here to close deals as that lies with our Education Sales. You’re here to make those deals matter: to activate, build stickiness, and create genuine long\-term impact in the institutions Canva enters.
   

  

**What You’ll Learn And Build**
* Deep expertise in education market development across MENAP — one of the most dynamic and culturally diverse regional education landscapes in the world.
* First\-hand experience building institutional partnerships and government relations at a high\-growth global technology company.
* Cross\-functional leadership skills, working across product, marketing, sales, and community to drive outcomes you influence but don’t directly own.
* The opportunity to build Canva’s MENAP education activation playbook from the ground up — a function with genuine regional and global visibility.

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the Amazon Marketplace Experience Transformation (AMET) function for Delivery Associates (DAs) and Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey. In this critical role, you will be based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, focusing on local operations while developing and executing the regional strategy. You will leverage multiple listening channels to identify experience priorities, consolidate feedback, and work cross\-functionally to address key improvement opportunities. This position requires exceptional stakeholder management and strategic thinking to create meaningful programs that enhance the overall driver and DSP experience across diverse markets.
   

  

 Your expertise in program management, strategy development, and influence without authority will be essential as you partner with external entities to create impactful campaigns, present strategies to senior leadership, and drive initiatives that transform the delivery partner experience. You will serve as the strategic voice for delivery partners, ensuring their needs are represented in business decisions while balancing operational excellence and partner satisfaction
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for delivery partner experience across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey, while maintaining focused implementation in Saudi Arabian operations.
* Collect and analyze insights from multiple listening channels to identify experience priorities, then work cross\-functionally with operations teams, ACES, and DEX teams to address structural challenges within established SLAs.
* Draft comprehensive strategy documents and present recommendations to senior leadership, driving alignment and securing resources for key initiatives.
* Establish and manage partnerships with external entities to create campaigns and benefits for Delivery Associates and DSPs, including organizing annual partner meetings and launching ignite events throughout the region.
* Lead country expansion efforts and new program launches within AMET, ensuring consistent implementation of best practices while adapting to local market needs.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 5\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in English\-language communication skills, both written and verbal


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.jd_text:
**TGP International**
 WE CREATE, DESIGN AND BUILD AWARD WINNING WORLD\-CLASS F\&B AND RETAIL BRANDS FOR OUR CLIENTS AND PARTNERS
   

  

 TGP International are a hospitality consultancy based in London and Dubai. We team up with passionate brands, clients and entrepreneurs to make their long\-term vision a reality through concept development, creative interior design, graphic design \& branding, franchising, advisory \& operational services and project management.
   

  

 Some of our clients include: Dubai Expo 2020, Marriott, Hilton, Waldorf Astoria, Harrods, Sushi Samba, Adrift Burger Bar, Nakheel Malls, Selfridges, Time Out Market, FIFA World Cup 2022, The National, and Tashas.
   

  

**Do you have a real passion for food and hospitality? Are you a foodie? Does the idea of creating world\-class restaurants, food halls and F\&B excite you?**
 As the world's leading hospitality agency, offering an outstanding 360 degree service to our clients, we are constantly striving to be the best and lead the sector in F\&B and hospitality consultancy. We need a driven and creative person to join our fun and dynamic team and have a direct contribution and client exposure on some of the world's leading projects.
   

  

**Requirements**
**The Role:** 
 Strategy \& Masterplanning Director
   

  

**The job location can be from any of our offices: London, Cairo, Dubai, Riyadh**
 The Strategy \& Masterplanning Director is responsible for leading and growing TGP's Strategy \& Masterplanning practice, ensuring the successful delivery of all strategic advisory projects while driving innovation, client satisfaction, commercial performance, and team development.
   

  

 As a senior client advisor, the Director will build trusted relationships with clients, taking the time to deeply understand their challenges, ambitions, operational realities, and commercial objectives. They will be responsible for translating complex business problems into clear strategic questions, designing analytical approaches that uncover actionable insights, and developing tailored solutions that create measurable value for clients.
   

  

 The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams through large\-scale research, data analysis, market evaluation, and strategic planning processes, transforming complex findings into compelling narratives, creative strategies, and inspirational recommendations that distinguish TGP from traditional consultancies.
   

  

 The role will also play a key part in growing TGP's market presence by identifying opportunities to expand client relationships, develop new service offerings, and position TGP as the leading hospitality strategy and experience consultancy in the region.
   

  

 The Director is responsible for upholding TGP's values, maintaining the reputation of the Advisory department, and acting as a champion of TGP's 5E Customer Service philosophy.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Strategy, Masterplanning \& Client Advisory


**Strategic Leadership**
* Lead the development, delivery and implementation of client\-facing hospitality strategy projects including:
* Master Planning
* Feasibility Studies
* Throughput Analysis
* Management Consultancy Services
* Operational Consultancy Services
* Brand Curation Services
* Market Assessments
* Concept Development
* Destination Strategy
* Asset Positioning
* Act as the senior strategic advisor on all strategy projects
* Lead project scoping, methodology development, timelines, resource planning, and delivery frameworks
* Provide final review and approval of all strategic outputs, recommendations, reports, and presentations
* Drive the evolution of TGP's strategic advisory services, methodologies, tools, and intellectual property


**Client Management \& Relationship Development**
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term client relationships founded on trust, credibility, and strategic value
* Invest time in understanding client businesses, operational challenges, investment objectives, stakeholder priorities, and market context
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and stakeholder engagement sessions to identify root causes of business challenges rather than simply responding to stated requirements
* Translate client needs into tailored strategic solutions that align with commercial, operational, and brand objectives
* Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships through cross\-selling, upselling, and introduction of wider TGP services
* Position TGP as a strategic partner rather than a transactional consultant


**Problem Definition \& Analytical Leadership**
* Lead teams through structured problem\-solving methodologies to clearly define client challenges and project objectives
* Design analytical frameworks and research methodologies that support evidence\-based decision making
* Guide teams through large and complex data analysis exercises, including market, operational, financial, customer, and competitive data
* Ensure insights are derived from data in a way that remains focused on solving client business problems rather than simply reporting findings
* Challenge assumptions and identify emerging trends, opportunities, risks, and innovation opportunities
* Drive clarity and alignment when working with ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting information


**Insight\-Led Strategy \& Innovation**
* Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling, and actionable strategic recommendations
* Develop creative and inspirational strategies that combine commercial rigour with innovative thinking
* Ensure recommendations are grounded in insight while pushing clients towards differentiated and future\-focused solutions
* Lead the creation of compelling strategic narratives that inspire confidence and support decision making
* Champion innovation, thought leadership, and trend analysis to ensure TGP remains ahead of industry developments
* Create strategic outputs that differentiate TGP from traditional consultancies through a combination of insight, creativity, practicality, and implementation focus
* Test new methodologies, technologies, and approaches while tracking effectiveness and outcomes
* Actively participate in TGP's 360 process from a strategic perspective
* Attend weekly Advisory and Design meetings to update leadership on project performance, team workload, and strategic opportunities
* Finance \& Profitability
* Monitor project billing, collection, and financial performance
* Develop and contribute to territory business plans and growth strategies
* Maximise revenue opportunities across strategy projects and wider TGP services
* Ensure profitability targets and project margins are achieved
* Negotiate third\-party consultant fees and supplier agreements
* Assess project feasibility and risk prior to partner approval
* Develop management information systems and performance reporting to support business growth and resource planning
* Contribute to annual budgeting and forecasting processes
* Review quarterly forecasts and identify performance variances
* Monitor territory profit and loss performance and recommend corrective actions where required
* Project Leadership


 (Where assigned as Project Lead)
   

  

* Coordinate and chair project meetings
* Manage project programmes, deliverables, and stakeholder communications
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to TGP quality standards
* Attend site visits, workshops, and client presentations
* Provide strategic leadership and subject matter expertise throughout project delivery
* Manage relationships with all external stakeholders
* Obtain stakeholder feedback and approvals as required
* Facilitate collaboration across TGP departments to ensure integrated project delivery
* Ensure strategic recommendations remain aligned with brand, commercial, and operational objectives
* Manage effective project handover between departments and project phases
* People Leadership
* Lead recruitment, retention, and development of the Strategy \& Masterplanning team
* Approve all strategy team recruitment decisions
* Develop workforce planning and resource allocation strategies
* Mentor and coach team members in consulting, analytical thinking, client management, and strategic problem solving
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Conduct monthly team meetings and regular performance reviews
* Develop personal development plans and career pathways for team members
* Lead intern and graduate development programmes
* Ensure resources are effectively managed to meet client commitments
* Communicate resource requirements and capacity challenges to the Leadership Team
* Business Development \& Market Growth
* Actively build market presence through conferences, industry events, thought leadership, and networking activities
* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and generate new business opportunities
* Lead strategic pitches, proposals, and presentations
* Support marketing initiatives with market insights, project learnings, and thought leadership content
* Maintain awareness of market trends, investor activity, hospitality innovation, and competitive movements
* Drive client retention, satisfaction, and long\-term relationship growth through TGP's 5E Customer Service philosophy
* Promote TGP's integrated 360 service offering across all client engagements
* Contribute to positioning TGP as the leading hospitality strategy, masterplanning, and experience consultancy in the region


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Economics, Real Estate, Urban Planning, Architecture, Strategy, or a related discipline
* Master's Degree (MBA or equivalent) desirable


**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years' experience in hospitality consulting, real estate advisory, strategy consulting, destination development, or management consultancy
* Minimum 2 years in a senior leadership role
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale strategic advisory projects
* Strong understanding of GCC hospitality, tourism, mixed\-use, and destination development sectors
* Experience managing senior client relationships and executive stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex analytical and strategic challenges


**Technical Skills \& Knowledge**
* Strategic Planning \& Business Transformation
* Hospitality \& Destination Strategy
* Masterplanning \& Feasibility Analysis
* Financial Modelling \& Commercial Analytics
* Market Research \& Data Analysis
* Client Relationship Management
* Facilitation \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Innovation \& Concept Development
* Business Development \& Proposal Writing
* GCC Market Knowledge
* Presentation \& Storytelling Skills
* Leadership \& Team Development


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking
* Commercial Acumen
* Client Centricity
* Analytical Problem Solving
* Creativity \& Innovation
* Executive Presence
* Influencing \& Negotiation
* Communication \& Storytelling
* Leadership \& Coaching
* Collaboration \& Team Building
* Results Orientation


**Benefits**
 TGP International Employee Benefits:
   

  

 Five\-Day Work Week: Standard Monday to Friday schedule.
   

  

 Hybrid Work Arrangement: Three days in the office and two days working remotely.
   

  

 Incentive Plan: Company incentive scheme offering up to 10%—5% for introductions and 5% for successful closures.
   

  

 Annual Leave: 22 working days of paid annual leave, excluding weekends.
   

  

 Remote Work Flexibility: One additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave.
   

  

 Coaching \& Mentoring: Structured professional development through a dedicated coaching and mentoring program.
   

  

 Annual Company Gathering: A global team event bringing together employees from all offices.
   

  

 Employee Recognition Program: Regular recognition initiatives celebrating outstanding performance and contributions.

data.jd_text:
**About Zamanat** 




 Zamanat is a Sharia\-aligned real\-world asset tokenisation platform. We structure and tokenise assets across funds, private credit, real estate and receivables, then distribute them through institutional, private wealth and on\-chain channels.
 



  





 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.
* Performance\-linked bonus tied to closed mandates, structuring fee revenue and playbook delivery.
* Equity or carry participation aligned to long\-term value creation
* Clear trajectory to Senior Director or MD as pipeline, AUM and team scale.
* Direct exposure to the CEO, partners, sponsors and Sharia governance.
* A foundational role in building a Sharia\-aligned tokenisation platform from the structuring layer up, with AI tooling embedded into the workflow from inception.

data.jd_text:
**About Us:** 




  





 talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50\+ countries
 **.** 




  





**About this rol** 
 e:
 



  





 We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real\-time tracking and payments.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
 



  





 We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




  




* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer\-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross\-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat



  





**What success looks like:** 




  





**By 90 days** 
 : You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
 



**By 6 months** 
 : Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
 



**By 12 months** 
 : You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
 







**Qualifications** 




  





**You must have** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform)
* 2\+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade\-offs between native vs cross\-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K\+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data



  





**Bonus if you have** 
 :
 


* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk\-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) or event\-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e\-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams



  





**This role is for you if...** 



* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought



  





**This role is NOT for you if...** 



* You want a pure people\-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow\-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices



  





 Additional information
 



  





**Your career growth path:** 




 Talabat operates a structured career framework with clearly defined levels for engineering leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, you'll enter an established progression that rewards growing impact, strategic ownership, and people leadership:
 



**Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
 



**Senior Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain\-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
 



**Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
 



**Senior Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company\-wide technical strategy, build director\-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

**Assistant Conference Producer**
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Conference Producer to help lead the research, development, and delivery of high\-quality conferences. The ideal candidate will be responsible for assisting in creating compelling agendas, securing senior\-level speakers and attendees, and ensuring each event delivers strong value for delegates, sponsors, partners, and stakeholders.
   

  

 This role requires excellent research, communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. The successful candidate will be confident engaging with C\-level executives and senior industry leaders across international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Research \& Programm Development:**
* Help research industry trends, market developments, and audience needs
* Help develop commercially viable conference agendas and event concepts
* Identify key discussion topics and emerging market opportunities
* Conduct competitor analysis and market mapping of industries into buyer and seller chains
* Research and build databases of target individuals suitable for speaking at events or attending advisory board meetings


**Identify targets according to:**
* Seniority level (e.g. CIO, CTO, CSO)
* Geographic focus
* Major companies within target markets
* Client recommendations


**Speaker Acquisition \& Management**
* Identify, approach, and secure senior\-level approved speakers and industry experts
* Invite, follow up, and confirm approved speakers via LinkedIn, email, and phone
* Achieve agreed monthly speaker confirmation targets across assigned events
* Build and maintain strong relationships with speakers, sponsors, clients, and industry stakeholders
* Manage and maintain accurate speaker invitation trackers at all times
* Keep live event agendas updated with confirmed speakers and allocated sessions
* Collect professional bios and high\-resolution speaker photos immediately upon confirmation
* Ensure event websites are continuously updated with speaker profiles and agenda changes


 Act as the main point of contact for all speaker communications regarding:
   

  

* Event participation
* Session content
* Travel and accommodation arrangements
* Event logistics and queries


**Assist with speaker travel budget allocation where required**
* Collect and organize speaker documentation needed for local event licensing procedures
* Send detailed speaker briefing documents covering both content and logistics
* Ensure speakers are fully briefed and event\-ready at least two weeks before the event
* Organize and attend Meet the Panel briefing sessions for moderators and panelists via Zoom or Microsoft Teams
* Ensure moderators distribute final discussion workflows ahead of sessions


**Advisory Board Management**
* Invite and secure approved advisory board participants through LinkedIn, email, and phone outreach
* Secure targeted attendance numbers for advisory board meetings conducted via Zoom or Microsoft Teams


 Coordinate meeting logistics including:
   

  

* Sending Teams/Zoom invitations
* Distributing agendas in advance
* Managing confirmations and reminders


 Attend and record advisory board meetings where applicable
   

  

**Maintain accurate attendee records including:**
* Names
* Job titles
* Company details
* Contact information


 Export and manage attendee data from meeting platforms where required
   

  

 Collect attendee bios and high\-resolution photos and ensure prompt website updates
   

  

**Event Project Management**
* Manage event timelines, production schedules, and key deliverables
* Coordinate closely with sales, marketing, sponsorship, and operations teams
* Ensure all programm content and speaker deliverables are completed on time
* Maintain high standards of organization and communication throughout the production cycle
* Support onsite event delivery and attend events where required
* Assist the Content Director with ad hoc research, production tasks, and event support


**Marketing \& Website Coordination**
* Work closely with the marketing team to support event promotion and audience engagement campaigns
* Prepare marketing brief for each event including event background, elevator pitch, target audiences, why they should attend, marketing taglines and agenda topics and features
* Ensure conference websites are consistently updated with the latest agendas, confirmed speakers, attendee information, and event announcements
* Upload and maintain accurate speaker bios, photos, session details, and advisory board information across event platforms
* Assist with the development and review of marketing copy including agenda descriptions, speaker highlights, email campaigns, and social media content
* Ensure all website content is accurate, professional, and aligned with brand standards and event timelines
* Support marketing initiatives by identifying compelling content and speaker announcements to help drive delegate registrations and engagement

data.raw_snippet:

**Key Accountabilities**
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose Summary**
 Provides an efficient, accurate and timely Contracts and Purchasing Service for internal clients according to University policies and procedures. Focuses on vendor management. Ensures that each purchase is value for money and cost effective.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 GENERAL PURCHASING
   

  

* Purchases a variety of goods and services for both Campuses from local and international sources in line with the University By\-Laws.
* Materials procured range from: computers (hardware, software, consumables, accessories), audio video equipment, office equipment, office and classroom furniture, lab equipment, printing materials, stationery, text books, periodicals, vehicles, building materials and renovation services, rental of equipment/vehicles and maintaining the University Insurance Policies (Public Liability, Fire, Burglary and Vehicular), for both campuses.
* Interprets purchase requests, investigates supply sources and negotiates best terms and conditions in line with user specifications.
* Scrutinizes specifications carefully to ensure that they are generic in nature during enquiry preparation stage, and to advise or obtain clarification from end user when such anomalies appear.
* Solicits quotations in line with the purchasing method approved by the Director/line manager. Scrutinizes vendor quotations and prepares bid summaries as required. Makes recommendations where possible.
* Vets and benchmarks prices obtained through referring to historical data, web published prices, and/or checking with end users to compare budgeted and estimated costs with actual prices.
* Expedites orders to ensure that goods and services are delivered within contractual deadlines and ensures that end users are kept advised of delivery situation at all times.
* Liaises with vendors regarding discrepancies and damage reports to ensure correct replacement of materials in accordance with order specifications.
* Issues amendments in case of increase/decrease of quantities and cancellation of orders and ensures accuracy of data at all times.
* Ensures through liaison with end users that vendor invoices routed for payment approval, are not held up without reason.
* When requested by line manager, must be able to produce and place on record the complete history of a specific purchase, for presentation or audit purposes.
* Answers vendor and client queries as required.


 TENDERS
   

  

* Prepares vendor tender documents complete with technical specifications, conditions, bill of quantities, date for opening envelopes, tender validity, terms of payment and guarantee, in line with the Director’s/line manager’s instructions.
* Monitors closing dates for tenders and ensures that tender opening sessions are held on the day of closing.
* Receives tender documents and prepares appropriate record in preparation of the tender opening session.
* Passes on all tenders with appropriate record to the tender opening committee.
* Forwards technical documents/catalogues to appointed Technical Committee for technical evaluation. Addresses clarifications arising from technical queries by evaluation teams.
* On receipt of technical evaluation from end user, opens Commercial envelopes and prepares the Bid Summary.
* On the advice of the Director/ line manager, prepares orders/fax of intent.
* Prepares blanket orders according to standards, procedures and University By\-Laws.
* Collects Performance Bonds and Bank Guarantees and maintains their security through the Finance Department. Returns bonds to unsuccessful vendors as required.
* Monitors contractual delivery and completion deadlines and liaises with Contracts Specialist for any delays in contract delivery.


**Other**
* Must be fully conversant with, and able to prepare and issue requests for quotations on the Tejari.com business to business exchange.
* Must be fully conversant with the Purchasing module of the Banner System and be able to process Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders in line with adopted procedures.
* Maintains confidentiality of purchasing information and does not disseminate information to any Party, unless authorized by the Director/line manager.
* Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of all procedures in the By\-Laws and the University’s purchasing terms and conditions.
* Must be conversant with the Storekeeper’s functions to fill in duties when required to do so.
* Identify, mitigate and escalate procurement risks to enable the organization to meet its obligations and maximize business opportunities
* Maintain and update procurement records and generate reports on procurement and contract activity to meet organizational compliance requirements and provide access to procurement information
* Performs other related duties as assigned and needed.


 DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE/COMPLEXITY OF ENVIRONMENT
   

  

* Works independently to deal with different clients while maintaining confidentiality and a professional manner. Coordinates and directs a variety of purchasing requests, tenders, queries and correspondence. Mainly works to meet deadlines and must be able to function under time constraints.


 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS/IMPACT OF INTERACTIONS
   

  

* Works closely with the Director/line manager, C\&P, members in the Department and other departments, particularly Finance to ensure that the complete procurement cycle is completed effectively, through payment of invoices to vendors.
* Must communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external clients.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Must possess a Minimum of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and 2 years relevant professional experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Experience working in a similar role in a government or higher education institution will be highly preferred.
   

  

**Other Requirements**
* Excellent computer skills required.
* Knowledge of purchasing procedures is preferred.
* Arabic/ English bilingual an asset.


 COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Communication \-Able to share information in an effective \& collaborative manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Customer \& Service Focused \- Demonstrates a spirit of service excellence
* Results \& Action Orientation \- Demonstrates initiative to generate improvements and foster positive outcomes.
* Builds Effective Interpersonal Relationships \- Demonstrates interpersonal effectiveness in the workplace.
* Knowledge \& Technical Competency \- Demonstrates proficiency in technical and job knowledge aspects of the position to achieve high level of performance. Able and willing to learn.

 **Eaton’s Global Data Center Segmen** 
 t.

 , this role ensures that quality is designed into execution—not inspected in after the fact—by establishing global standards, assurance mechanisms, testing rigor, and process discipline that scale across regions, customers, and service offers. data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.
* Established relationships with key regional rail clients, authorities or delivery partners would be advantageous.

 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
**About Moove** 




 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
 



 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
 



  





**What You’ll be Doing** 




 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
 



 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
 



  





 Core Responsibilities
 


* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.



  





**What You will need for this position** 



* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.



  





**Key Metrics** 



* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.



  





**Who You'll Be Working with:** 




 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
 



  





**About the team** 




 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
 



 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
 



**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
 



**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

**Account Director – Social, Content, Influencer \& Performance** 




**Company:** 
 Techne Agency
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai (Managing a UK team) / Hybrid or Remote (with travel when required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Start Date:** 
 Q3 2026
 



  





**About Techne Agency** 





 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and website content, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 





 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and technology, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record of results across the UK, UAE and Europe.
 





 Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European and UAE markets. This international footprint allows us to combine cultural relevance, creative execution and performance expertise across multiple markets.
 





 As the agency continues to grow, we are building a senior leadership layer to support this expansion. We are looking for someone who can help shape the future of the business, elevate our standards and play a key role in delivering exceptional work across all clients.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We're looking for a senior operator to lead client delivery across the agency and act as the right hand to the Founder \& CEO.
 





 This is a pivotal role within Techne, offering the opportunity to take ownership of high\-profile client relationships, shape the quality and direction of our work, and build a delivery function designed to scale.
 





 This is not a traditional account management role. You will operate across multiple disciplines — combining strategic oversight, team leadership and hands\-on execution to ensure consistently exceptional output. You'll manage the team, own the day\-to\-day, and be the person who keeps everything moving to a high standard.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Leadership** 



* Own senior client relationships across our European and UAE portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for strategy, performance and escalation
* Lead communication and direction across retainers and projects, ensuring accounts are proactively managed
* Identify and drive growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new business where relevant
* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

At Genius we are hiring for a role of
 **Manager Operations\-\-Home Delivery** 
 for a leading FMCG client
 



**Location Dubai** 




 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Delivery Operations Management
 


* Oversee and manage end\-to\-end delivery operations across all outlets and brands.
* Ensure compliance with company standards, food safety regulations, and operational procedures.
* Maintain delivery infrastructure readiness, including staffing, systems, packaging, and logistics processes.
* Monitor and improve operational KPIs including SLA adherence, delivery delays, cancellations, refunds, customer ratings, and order accuracy.
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks in coordination with outlet management teams.
* Conduct regular operational audits to ensure consistency and service excellence.



 2\. Aggregator \& Partner Management
 


* Manage relationships with third\-party delivery aggregators and logistics partners.
* Negotiate commercial terms, commissions, service level agreements (SLAs), and partnership conditions.
* Monitor promotional campaigns, marketing activities, and platform visibility.
* Optimize advertising spend, discount structures, and promotional ROI.
* Ensure partner compliance and resolve operational or technical issues promptly.



 3\. Sales, Marketing \& Growth
 


* Drive delivery sales growth and profitability across all brands and markets.
* Plan and execute delivery\-focused marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Analyze campaign performance and implement strategies to maximize ROI.
* Support the development and expansion of dark kitchens and virtual brands.
* Optimize menu engineering, pricing strategies, and product availability to maximize revenue.



 4\. Customer Experience Management
 


* Manage and resolve escalated customer complaints related to delivery operations.
* Monitor customer feedback trends and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate documentation, tracking, and resolution of customer feedback and service issues.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and service quality standards.



 5\. Reporting \& Analytics
 


* Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly operational and commercial reports.
* Analyze sales performance, delivery KPIs, customer behavior, and operational trends.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for business improvement.
* Develop dashboards and performance tracking mechanisms to support data\-driven decision\-making.



 6\. Compliance \& Quality Assurance
 


* Ensure adherence to company policies, operational standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular audits and compliance checks across all delivery operations.
* Maintain and improve quality assurance processes to ensure consistent service standards.



 7\. Contract Management
 


* Manage contracts and agreements with delivery aggregators, logistics providers, and external partners.
* Track contract renewals, compliance obligations, and commercial performance.
* Ensure all agreements align with company objectives and operational requirements.



 8\. Strategic Planning \& Expansion
 


* Support new outlet openings, market expansions, and brand launches.
* Conduct feasibility studies and operational assessments for new delivery initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to long\-term delivery growth strategies and business development initiatives.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Delivery sales and order growth
* SLA and delivery time adherence
* Customer satisfaction and ratings
* Order accuracy and cancellation rates
* Refund and complaint reduction
* Cost control and operational efficiency
* Campaign performance and ROI
* Aggregator relationship performance
* Profitability of delivery operations



 Qualifications \& Requirements
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in delivery operations, food service, QSR, or multi\-unit operations management.
* Strong understanding of delivery aggregators, food delivery platforms, and logistics operations.
* Proven experience in KPI management, sales growth, and operational optimization.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and operational dashboards.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-market environment.
