data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Be responsible for driving delivery of large scale internal development and vendor tender across Emirates Network Operations. The environment is fast paced, with tight timelines and high operational impact. The focus is on delivering internally built systems as well as tendering for a large vendor implementations.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.
* Experience in operational domains such as network operations, crew management or rostering will be an advantage, particularly where delivery impacts live operations.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

 A confidential private development group is seeking a Development Director to lead a major hospitality\-led real estate development in Iraq.
 



  





 This is a senior client\-side role focused on the planning, structuring, and progression of a landmark destination scheme including hotel, resort, residential, wellness, leisure, retail, infrastructure, and public realm components.
 



  





 Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, the Development Director will be responsible for driving the development strategy, coordinating consultants and operators, managing design progression, and ensuring the project is commercially, operationally, and technically aligned as it moves through early\-stage development and into delivery readiness.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 The Development Director will lead the development planning and execution strategy across a complex destination project, working closely with senior leadership, investors, hotel operators, branded residence partners, design consultants, technical advisors, commercial teams, and future delivery teams.
 



  





 Key responsibilities will include:
 


* Leading the overall development strategy, asset positioning, phasing, and land use planning
* Managing hospitality, resort, branded residence, wellness, leisure, and supporting real estate components
* Coordinating hotel operator engagement, technical services requirements, brand standards, and approval processes
* Managing master planners, architects, engineers, hospitality designers, cost consultants, and specialist advisors

* Supporting development appraisals, feasibility studies, financial models, investment papers, and development budgets
* Establishing governance, reporting structures, milestone tracking, and decision making processes

* Managing external stakeholders, consultants, operators, investors, lenders, and regulatory bodies

**Job Summary** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager for Renewables and Batteries will provide and coordinate technical and engineering input into the identification, due diligence, development, and delivery of utility scale renewable energy projects (wind, solar, BESS and hybrid) in feasibility stage, development stage, and tender/bid stage. These technical and engineering inputs will include technology selection, balance of plant design, grid connection works, development of technical documentation to support procurement activities, and overview of installation, construction, commissioning, testing of works, warranty and operational support of existing and new projects.
 



  





  





**Reporting** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager Renewables will be part of the Engineering and Technical Support (ETS) team for Renewables and Batteries within the GCC and will report to the Head of Engineering MENA.
 



  





  





**Key Accountabilities** 




 • Manage and coordinate engineering work packages with respect to choice of technologies, technical configurations and for setting relevant performance, statutory, safety and quality requirements.
 



 • In charge of all aspects and documentation of the contractual negotiations during Business Development of all O\&M and/or Technical\-related agreements: EPC, EPCM, PPA, OE, LTSA, etc.
 



 • Work closely with the procurement and construction team in line with the procurement strategies and construction strategies.
 



 • Be responsible for drafting/contributing to and negotiating owner specifications, including the incorporation of the latest group experience and standards.
 



 • Prepare Capex and O\&M budgets integrating feedback from Group assets and Group specialists.
 



 • Prepare all O\&M technical related documents for the bid (OM organization chart, O\&M references, O\&M Philosophy, etc.).
 



 • Interface with Lender's Engineer and support Lenders’ due diligence during closing process.
 



 • Management of internal approval process (O\&M and Technical).
 



 • Support of CEO and Construction Managers of Project Companies or CEO and Plant Managers of O\&M Companies, for punctual problems during construction, commissioning phase and during operations.
 



 • Perform technology watch and share knowledge within the ETS team
 



  





  





**Degree / Experience** 




 • Degree in an engineering discipline, bachelors or masters
 



 • Minimum of 15 years of experience in the power generation sector with specific knowledge, expertise and experience in developing or constructing solar PV and/or BESS projects including the ability to:
 



 o evaluate and perform feasibility studies
 



 o conduct technology configurations
 



 o determine construction strategies and operating philosophies
 



 o evaluate yield assessments and conceptual designs
 



 o perform techno\-economic cost analyses for the full lifecycle of a project
 



 o draft, review and negotiate commercial and contractual agreements
 



 o manage and advise transversally on all technical aspects of a project from cradle to grave
 



 • Minimum 10 years of experience in a project management or technical coordination function on solar PV or BESS development or construction projects. Formal training in project management is strongly desirable;
 



 • Knowledge in other renewable technologies such as Wind would be advantageous.
 



 • Knowledge in procurement (e.g. FIDIC) and handling multidisciplinary projects are considered strong assets;
 



 • A basic understanding of HV/MV/LV electrical systems, including international practices on grid connection for centralized energy projects, as well as electrical system integration \& optimization for industrial customers.
 



 • Knowledge and experience working on competitive tenders in the Middle East would be advantageous.
 



  





  





**Behavioral Competencies** 




 • Strong people management skills;
 



 • Flexible, meticulous, good planner, and organizer.
 



 • Ability to work autonomously and be proactive.
 



 • Stress resistant, results\-focused, determined, decisive;
 



 • You think outside the box and dare to challenge the status quo;
 



  





  





**Business Understanding** 




 • Participation on and closing of several utility scale renewable energy projects.
 



 • Development and activities internationally and in MENA in particular.
 



 • Interfaces with Business Development (BD) / Legal / Procurement / Acquisitions, Investments \& Financial Advisory (AIFA) / Construction / Operations.
 



 • O\&M and/or construction knowledge
 



  





  





**Location/travel** 




 Dubai Office with travel in GCC plus episodic travels inside and outside the MENA region.
 



 • Flexibility to travel in the AMEA region if needed.

 Revenue Recognition \& Financial Control

data.jd_text:
**Jw Turner Contracting LLC** 
 , an affiliate of Paris Group, is an in\-house provider of high\-quality fit\-out and maintenance services, specializing in retail and hospitality projects. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional results by ensuring that every detail of the project is meticulously planned and executed. We are currently seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager \- Fit out Exp** 
 with a strong background in the fit\-out industry to join our dynamic team.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 As
 **Project Manager \- fit out Exp** 
 , you will be responsible for overseeing the planning, execution, and delivery of fit\-out projects from inception to completion. You will ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards while maintaining excellent client relationships. This role requires a highly organized, detail\-oriented professional with proven experience in managing fit\-out projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Planning and developing the project idea to define the concept and create a process to bring it to fruition, including setting and managing management expectations, developing a detailed project plan, defining the scope of the project, and assigning team members to specific tasks.
* Discussing the final design approved by the management with the design architects and understand all its aspects and expectations.
* Taking the lead in planning and analyzing specifications to provide clear, pursuable, and coordinated interpretation of the design/drawings for the execution of all company projects and coordinate with the execution team.
* Ensuring that all projects are delivered on time, monitoring the project stage of completion, making reports, and sending them to management.
* Following and making sure to get all the government approvals for all the projects.
* Reporting project risks and outcomes to appropriate management channels, and escalating issues according to the project work plan
* Arranging the decoration and finishing material.
* Monitoring troubleshooting and timely completion of the projects stage\-wise as per the plan.
* Organizing and following up on the job, creating an accurate timeline of project completion to ensure tasks are finished within the confines of the assignment and being aware of how the project is progressing.
* Developing and maintaining a project status that tracks overall progress and achievement of set milestones as per plan.
* Ensuring all quality tests and inspections are performed, witnessed, and documented according to the approved procedures.
* Serving as a point of communication between company teams and external resources
* Reporting to the management with a detailed report in case the project is delayed explaining the response and the cost of this delay.
* Handling, dealing with, and assisting in resolving all the issues with all external contractors and third\-party service providers and suppliers.
* Performing other tasks that might be assigned from time to time.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture or related field.
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of UAE experience in project management, with solid experience in managing high\-value fit\-out projects
* Strong knowledge of fit\-out processes, construction methodologies, project management software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, Procore), budgeting tools, local building codes and regulations.
* Proven ability to lead teams, communicate effectively, and build strong relationships with clients, contractors, and suppliers.
* Excellent ability to identify potential issues and resolve them efficiently to keep projects on track.
* PMP (Project Management Professional), or similar project management certifications are preferred.

 **talent@parisgroup.ae** 
 with the subject line “Applicant –
 **Project Manager \- Fit out Exp** 
 ”.

data.jd_text:
We're partnering with a rapidly scaling technology business that is transforming one of the region's largest and most complex industries through AI, automation, and data\-driven innovation.
 



  





 Backed by a well\-established regional group and operating with the agility of a startup, the company is building next\-generation products that are redefining how businesses and customers interact across a highly transactional environment.
 



  





 As part of its next phase of growth, the company is seeking an exceptional Head of Engineering to lead the technology function, shape engineering culture, and drive the execution of an ambitious AI\-powered product roadmap.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity for a hands\-on engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, product, and business.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the executive leadership team, you will take ownership of engineering strategy, team development, architecture, delivery excellence, and AI innovation. You will inherit a capable team and be responsible for elevating engineering standards, improving delivery velocity, and building a world\-class technology organization capable of scaling across the region.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems through technology, has experience building and scaling high\-performing engineering teams, and remains deeply involved in technical decision\-making.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Define and execute the company's engineering vision and technical strategy.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a multi\-disciplinary engineering team across multiple locations.
* Drive engineering excellence, delivery quality, and operational effectiveness across all products and platforms.
* Establish modern software development practices, CI/CD processes, testing frameworks, monitoring, and observability standards.
* Partner closely with Product and Design leadership to deliver customer\-centric solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend, AI, and data platforms.
* Build and mature AI and automation capabilities, including agentic AI systems and intelligent workflow automation.
* Improve engineering productivity, release cadence, system reliability, and security posture.
* Develop strong technical leadership within the organization through coaching, succession planning, and selective hiring.
* Act as the senior technical voice within the leadership team, providing guidance on technology investments, risk management, scalability, and innovation.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years leading engineering teams.
* Previous experience as a Head of Engineering, VP Engineering, CTO, Co\-Founder, or equivalent senior technology leadership role.
* Proven track record of scaling engineering organizations in high\-growth startup, scale\-up, or technology\-driven environments.
* Strong hands\-on technical background with the ability to review architecture, contribute to technical discussions, and guide engineering direction.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across product, design, engineering, and data functions.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, cloud technologies, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.
* Experience building products in fast\-paced environments where reliability, speed, and customer experience are critical.
* Demonstrated success improving software delivery processes, engineering culture, and operational maturity.



  





 Highly Desirable
 


* Production experience with AI\-powered products, LLM applications, agentic AI systems, or intelligent automation platforms.
* Experience working within SaaS, platform businesses, marketplaces, CRM ecosystems, or transaction\-heavy environments.
* Exposure to data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and AI\-driven product development.
* Startup founder or early\-stage leadership experience.
* Experience managing distributed engineering teams.



  





 Why Join?
 


* Opportunity to shape the future of a high\-growth technology business with significant market impact.
* Direct access to executive leadership and strategic decision\-making.
* Significant ownership, influence, and autonomy.
* Meaningful equity participation.
* Well\-funded environment with long\-term growth ambitions.
* Opportunity to build industry\-leading AI products and engineering capabilities.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with the pace and excitement of a startup.



  





 This is a career\-defining opportunity for a technology leader who wants to build, scale, and leave a lasting impact on a business undergoing significant transformation.
 



  





 Location: Dubai, UAE (Onsite)
 



  





 Candidates currently based in the UAE will be highly preferred.

data.jd_text:
The role holder is responsible for managing the FM operations and maintenance activities in accordance with defined DHAM FM standards and processes with the objective of enhancing customer satisfaction, minimizing customer complaints, and maximizing revenue and profitability of the respective DHAM entity.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**Support with Budgeting** 



* Assist the department head in the preparation of annual operation and capital budgets.
* Monitor budget and highlight budget variances to ensure cost efficiencies in line with the scorecard for OPEX saving and
* Execution of approved CAPEX project in a timely manner.



**FM Operations** 



* Manage the team of FM Executive and FM Service Provider team for smooth daily FM operations.
* Monitor of FM Service Provider in delivery of services including Soft Services (Cleaning, Pest Control, Landscaping waste management etc.) and hard services (including reactive and preventive maintenance, as well all specialized services for critical and non\-critical equipment and ensure work is carried out as per agreed SLA and prepare snag reports.
* Supervise activities within the assigned community/asset, conduct regular meetings with internal \& external teams to monitor progress of FM activities and to ensure compliance with the agreed standards and requirements.
* Conduct regular site visits and promptly address identified issues.
* Responsible and manages DHAM CAFM system (Maximo) and its utilization on respective site.
* Monitor and maintain records of utilities expenditure and implement initiatives of sustainability and utilities cost saving projects.
* Represent the business unit during design, planning, construction, and handover stages of the newly developed assets to oversee FM requirements.
* Oversee activities directly related to regulatory requirements of life safety systems and ensure necessary certifications are obtained on time.
* Assist the fit\-out activities in DHAM’s assets to ensure compliance with the scope of work, HSE requirements and building’s standards.
* Assist business partners and their contractors with details on the requirements related to technical aspects, FM issues, fit\-out process and issue the necessary permits.
* Ensure FM records are created and maintained for all assigned sites such as site logbooks to demonstrate full operational procedures are followed.
* Ensure effective use of CAFM to ensure all Service Requests and Work Orders are tracked for timely completion in line with SLA requirements.
* Ensure new DHAM assets being brought into operations are entered onto pre\-planned maintenance program and subject to QA procedures.
* Planning future enhancement requirements by forecasting the facility’s upcoming needs and requirements.
* Identify gaps and deficiencies in services, advice, and effect solutions as part of Continuous Improvement on FM services rendered.
* Explore and recommend innovative methods, based on best practices, in order to bring about cost\-effective solutions.
* Writes and provides monthly operational and technical reports.



**Tendering \& Procurement** 



* Prepare SOW documents for FM operational services for new buildings and conduct necessary technical evaluation of the submitted proposals.
* Prepare scope of work for (operational variables and capex projects).
* Initiate procurement process, liaise with procurement department during the tendering process, review vendor responses and issue GRNs.
* Recommend procurement of appropriate supplies and equipment according to the operational needs.



**Vendor Management** 



* Ensure the service provider attends to all re\-active service requests from various stakeholders and in compliant with the agreed SLAs.
* Monitor SLAs and KPIs of the outsourced contractors and track performance levels of the contractor providing soft services against set KPIs and SLAs by routinely assessing performance.
* Maintain effective communication with suppliers, business departments and clients and provide active support in the delivery of services by suppliers as per SLAs and QHSE standards.
* Review and certify service provider’s monthly performance and payment certificate.
* Ensures that Service providers use DHAM CAFM systems for all service requests.



**Customer Complaint Management** 



* Ensure customer complaints are timely and appropriately managed and closed to achieve organization’s customer satisfaction targets.
* Ensure that Voice of Customer scores are meeting the minimum required for the FM Department.



**Cross Functional Coordination** 



* Conduct monthly meetings with FM service provider, HSE, security, and contractors to assess the contractor’s performance, HSE requirements, identify non\-compliance and action plans.
* Support the business development team in timely resolution of their queries related to facilities management in coordination with applicable internal departments.
* Manage project’s takeover from asset development and conduct necessary inspection, witness testing \& commissioning and manage rectification of defects and snags during the DLP in coordination with Asset Development Team and contractor.



**Continual Improvement** 



* Identify and recommend to the business unit and department head major improvements (technical and feel \& look) required to enhance the existing facilities.
* Contribute to the process of identifying facilities management best practices and development of formal processes and practices as necessary towards integrating and embedding sustainable principles and strategies into daily operational practices.
* Drive improvement in water and electricity saving and sustainability initiatives.



  





  





 Minimum Qualification:
 



  




* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Facilities Management.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* A professional qualification in real estate and / or facilities management (IWFM) or equivalent is desirable.



 Experience:
 


* Minimum 7\-9 years’ experience in a facilities management related role in a similar organization.



  





 Technical Competencies
 



  




* Demonstrable knowledge of the full spectrum of facilities management functions, including hard and soft services, contract management, tendering, business development etc.
* Maintain a calm demeanor with the ability to remain un\-flustered and maintain a cool head in different situations.
* Excellent negotiation and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with colleagues, contractors and key stakeholders.
* Excellent knowledge of maintenance and operations management.
* Knowledge of Health and Safety standards is advantageous.
* Demonstrate a full understanding of statutory legislation as it relates to the built environment.
* Ability to find pragmatic solutions and adapt to changing situations.
* Excellent communication skills. Arabic is advantageous.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced Insurance Project Lead to drive the delivery of a series of large, strategic transformation initiatives across the organization. This role combines strong program governance and execution expertise with strategic portfolio oversight to manage a complex pipeline of initiatives, drive enterprise\-wide prioritization, and ensure the realization of measurable business value.
 



  





 The successful candidate will operate across all three business lines—Personal, Commercial, and Medical—partnering closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders to manage demand intake, shape and scope initiatives, and deliver complex programs end\-to\-end within a structured Transformation Framework. The role is accountable for aligning initiatives to strategic objectives, managing interdependencies, mitigating risk, and ensuring clear benefits realization.
 



 This position reports directly to the Country Head of Transformation
 



  





**Key Role ResponsibilitiesProgram Delivery \& Governance** 



* Accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of a portfolio of large, strategic transformation projects, ensuring alignment to enterprise objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish and maintain robust program governance structures, ensuring clear decision\-making, oversight, and alignment across business units and executive stakeholders.
* Drive integrated program planning, proactively managing interdependencies, critical paths, resource capacity, and sequencing across multiple concurrent projects.
* Accountable to ensure each program is aligned to the Liva Transformation Framework and adopt and report in line with the program delivery framework.
* Provide consolidated program reporting, including dashboards, KPIs, financial tracking, risks, issues, and benefits realization updates to Senior Leadership and the Country Head of Transformation.
* Ensure effective scope, schedule, cost, and quality control across all projects within the program, applying strong delivery discipline and risk management practices.
* Oversee the development and approval of business cases, including clear articulation of strategic rationale, benefits, investment requirements, and return on investment.
* Ensure all initiatives are delivered in accordance with the Transformation Framework, maintaining consistency in standards, controls, and governance.
* Partner with senior business stakeholders to define program scope, shape solutions, and ensure requirements are clearly documented and aligned to intended outcomes.
* Oversee testing, implementation, and business readiness activities across the program to ensure smooth deployment, stakeholder adoption, and realization of defined benefits.



  





**Knowledge/ Skills/ Competencies Required** 



* Minimum 2\-4 years experience in the Insurance sector.
* Proven experience as a Project Lead, leading portfolios of interrelated projects within regulated insurance environments across Personal, Commercial, and Medical insurance lines.
* Professionally certified in program and/or project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Six Sigma or equivalent).
* Strong industry knowledge of underwriting, policy administration, claims, pricing, regulatory compliance, and the end\-to\-end insurance lifecycle, with particular expertise in medical/health insurance frameworks.
* Demonstrated success delivering large\-scale enterprise transformation and change programs, including core system modernisation, regulatory initiatives, and operating model redesign.
* Expertise in managing complex program backlogs and multiple concurrent initiatives, ensuring strategic alignment, prioritisation discipline, and effective risk and dependency management.
* Advanced capability in business case development, cost\-benefit analysis, and structured benefits realisation across program lifecycles.
* Strong executive stakeholder engagement and governance leadership, overseeing requirements (BRDs), testing/UAT coordination, release control, and establishing scalable delivery frameworks in complex environments.

data.raw_snippet: A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, em
data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience operating across the Middle East and/or Africa region, including working with local regulatory, cultural, and commercial environments
* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies
* Knowledge of Ecolab’s industries — Institutional, Industrial, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pest Elimination — is a plus
* Additional regional languages (Arabic, French) a plus
* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**
* Business and commercial acumen — understands P\&L, growth levers, customer economics, and how technology and AI investments translate into commercial outcomes
* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps
* Leadership presence to motivate and develop diverse, multi\-country teams
* Manage by influence — collaborates across global Enterprise AI groups to develop talent and drive results
* Focus and decisiveness — enables action and progress even when faced with ambiguity
* Executive communication — strong stakeholder management at C\-suite and Market leadership level


*Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with a disability.*
**About Enterprise AI At Ecolab**
 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.
   

  

 Join us, and help shape what comes next — for Ecolab, for our customers, and for the planet.
   

  

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

 Our client is a leading Real Estate Developer in Dubai

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. * Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.

* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.

**Skills Required:**

data.jd_text:
**General Description**
 The position is responsible for supporting Chief Risk Officer / HEAD GRCI for all aspects of the risk delivery. The DGM is also responsible for supporting the CRO/HEAD GRCI in overseeing the daily operations and overall management of the Division. The DGM ensures that GRCI agendas are met efficiently, while maintaining high standards of performance, operational effectiveness and divisional growth in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI. The person will work closely with CRO/HEAD GRCI, implementing Enterprise Risk Management Framework focusing on Tier 1 \& 2 risk reporting i.e. Strategic, Operational, Projects \& Investment Risks. The person shall also assist the CRO / HEAD in other strategic initiatives. The person shall coordinate with other functional areas in the Company to ensure all risks in the Company are identified, measured, mitigated/managed, and monitored/reported. On top of that, the person shall ensure insurance adequacy and address all queries on all lines of insurances promptly.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Collaborate with the CRO/HEAD GRCI, to adapt and implement Group risk policies, frameworks, and operating models tailored to organizational needs.
* Assist the CRO/HEAD GRCI in preparing and managing matters reported to Risk, Sustainability and Governance (RSGC) Committee reporting. Responsibilities include drafting Agenda, tracking and addressing Matters Arising, preparing and reviewing reports such as Risk Management Report, Group Technology Reports, Sustainability Report and Other Agenda Papers (Hospital License, Anti\- Bribery Management System (ABMS), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Report from Medical Advisory Committee (GMACCG), Key Sentinel/Major Incidents quarterly reporting and other papers required by RSGC.
* Identify key risks and their indicators in risk reporting and monitoring, oversee the development and execution of mitigation plans.
* Lead the end to end risk management process for KPJ in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI which includes an analysis of the financial and non\-financial impact when risks occur.
* Lead the end\-to\-end risk management process in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI, including identifying, quantifying, mitigating, and monitoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, project and investment risks).
* To partner with the Head of Group Services and Head of Business Units to ensure that all Risks (Tier 1 \& 2\) risks including investment, project risks, top risk and top emerging risks are being considered in their strategic or operational initiatives. This also includes ESG \& ABC risk identification and mitigation, implementation of appropriate risk management systems and loss event database are properly identified, quantified, managed and monitored.
* Partner and collaborate with other Line of Defence including Group Legal \& Advisory Services (GLAS), Group Clinical (GC), Internal Audit Services (IAS), Compliance \& Integrity Unit within GRCI and Group Sustainability Services (GSS) to to drive implementation of integrated risk management framework.
* Key activities include:
* Regularly updating and monitoring high\-risk medical malpractice active cases and sentinel events at hospitals that could result in viral or reputational damage.
* Coordinating with Internal Audit to synchronize audit plans and analyze findings for actionable insights.
* Collaborating with the Compliance and Integrity Unit to identify and address top risks and emerging ABC (Anti\-Bribery and Corruption) risks effectively.
* Ensuring the adoption and integration of appropriate risk management systems and maintaining a comprehensive loss event database for enhanced risk visibility and mitigation.
* To review and provide an independent assessment view on the key risks associated with projects \& investment undertaken with focus on Investment Risks.
* To review and challenge the proposals submitted by Hospitals or Subsidiaries on investment of new towers, renovations, major acquisition of assets and divestments by assessing their assumptions, investment costs, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, stress testing to evaluate the project resilience under various market conditions.
* Be the subject matter expert and change agent on ERM.
* Review the key risks associated with proposed major investments and projects (M\&As).
* Perform horizon scanning to identify emerging risks which may impact the organisation arising from changes in the external environment.
* Highlight emerging risks through flash report and emerging risk updates.
* Drive and champion risk initiatives/ innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
* leveraging analytics, machine learning and automation.
* Champion innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
* Use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to anticipate risks, especially for high\-impact areas like market changes, operational disruptions, or cybersecurity.
* Create a real\-time, enterprise\-wide dashboard that consolidates all key risk metrics for better oversight and transparency.
* Develop and deliver outreach and engagement activities in support of embedding and strengthening risk management culture and awareness.
* Engage more deeply with middle management and front\-line staff to embed risk awareness and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Delivering impactful risk management training.
* Recommend professional certifications and ERM training syllabus for skill enhancement among ERM professionals.
* Encourage your team to pursue certifications in advanced risk management, sustainability, or digital tools to improve their skillsets.
* Actively participate in risk forums and discussions with senior management to align risk strategies with business goal.
* Other business units/functions – Execute and deliver initiatives on a regular basis to identify unique/emerging risks and design risk management strategies to address the risks identified.
* Perform adhoc independent risk review and validation for any request on Group’s undertakings.
* Develop ERM risk reporting/dashboard, timely communicate/escalate risk events, issues, and compliance with risk policies and limits to key stakeholders in the Company and in the region; manage the Company’s quarterly risk reporting.
* Regularly review the Risk Management framework and the operating structure for identifying, assessing, managing and monitoring the risks.
* Execute the annual Risk Management processes with key business, stakeholders, update the risk assessment and ensure adequate measures are in place to mitigate the identified risks.
* Monitor the risk appetite, identifying key risk management strategies, assessing and profiling of the key risks affecting the achievement of the business plans at group, business division and at a department level.
* Develop, refine and review the Risk Register and evaluate the relevance of risks identified across business units in the Group.
* Assist Senior Management team in improving risk management / mitigating strategies and techniques, and carrying out follow up action plans and its effectiveness in mitigating / controlling risks.
* Review and evaluate the effectiveness of implementation of action plans for risk management \- provide assurance on whether the risk mitigation process is being driven effectively and efficiently, whilst also continuously monitoring of whether the risk register is being updated appropriately.
* Evaluate and draw attention to possible gaps in the risk register to the Senior Management and Head of Services \- follow\-up on the development of control environment to overcome deficiencies in the risk management / mitigating process.
* Collaborate working with relevant functions (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Finance and Legal) to build up and/or implement a risk control framework (i.e. compliance self\-assessment) and provide quality and solutions\-focused advice on risk and control issues relevant to the business division for informed decision\-making on compliance and ethics matters.
* Align ERM practices more closely with KPJ’s long\-term strategic objectives, Academic Health System, Center of Excellence, digital transformation and market expansion.
* Review and challenge the Annual Strategic Planning initiatives and monitor the execution of strategies closely.
* Collaborate closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to address the increasing threat of data breaches and cyberattacks.
* Direct engagement and review on insurance related queries on medical malpractise, general, directors \& liabilities and other lines of insurance coverage.
* Assess and review the adequacy of insurance coverage on an annual basis and present to relevant Committees for renewal.
* To systematically strategize to ensure effectiveness in handling incidents, ensuring a proactive and efficient approach to incident resolution at the Hospital and/or HQ to avoid escalation of incident into crisis.
* To continuously conduct coaching/guidance through on the job training and regular one to one session.
* Act as a key support to the CRO/HEAD GRCI in representing the GRCI in board meetings, committees, and industry forums
* Represent the CRO/HEAD in Management meetings, committees, or forums when required.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the design and implementation of compliance programs that align with local and international regulations.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI in ensure effective monitoring of compliance risks, including anti\-money laundering (AML), anti\-bribery and corruption (ABC) and data privacy.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to develop and promote a robust integrity framework, ensuring the organization adheres to ethical standards and best practices.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the implementation of whistleblowing mechanisms, ethics training programs, and conflict of interest management processes.
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of integrity initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational values in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting/Finance
* Chartered Accountant, Certified Risk Professional, Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) would be an added advantage
* ▪Minimum 15 years relevant working experience with minimum 5 years at Management Level
* Professional Paper, Career stint in a Big 4 accounting firm, Healthcare industry experience
* Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Investment \& Finance

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you energized by partnering with senior leaders to enable business success through people\-focused solutions? As Head of HR, you will work closely with leaders and their leadership teams across the Middle East with focus on UAE and Saudi\-Arabia to support the delivery of the people agenda.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a trusted HR advisor on a broad range of people and organizational topics, helping leaders translate business priorities into effective people actions and play an important role in supporting leadership teams through change, organizational development, talent decisions, and workforce planning.
   

  

 This role combines senior HR partnering with hands\-on execution of (a.o.) HR cycle topics.
   

  

**What are my job responsibilities?**
**Strategic HR Leadership \& People Advisory**
* Act as a strategic advisor to Executive Management on all HR and workforce\-related matters
* Partner with leaders to design organizations that effectively support both operational and office\-based teams
* Translate business priorities into practical people\-centered actions that resonate across all workforce segments
* Lead employee relations initiatives, including dispute resolution and organizational interventions


**Workforce Planning, Talent \& Employee Lifecycle**
* Lead workforce planning aligned with business growth and operational realities
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle processes
* Partner with leadership on hiring strategies, workforce structures, and succession planning
* Ensure smooth onboarding and integration, especially for expatriate and site\-based employees
* Ensure attraction, development, and retention of talent while maintaining workforce stability


**Employee Relations, Labour Law \& Compliance**
* Manage employee relations and labor matters in line with UAE \& KSA labor laws
* Act as a key point of contact for complex employee relations matters, with strong on\-the\-ground involvement
* Build trust with blue\-collar employees through visibility, accessibility, and consistent communication
* Support leaders in resolving employee issues, conflicts, and workplace challenges
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant HR practices
* Develop and implement HR policies and conduct audits to ensure governance and continuous improvement


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Implement performance management practices aligned with business goals

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  




  


**Please apply directly through with your application and kindly only contact our Recruitment team for any further details, legal experiance is essential part of the criteria for this role.**
  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.
   

  

 •Maintain close and regular communication with HR throughout the performance review cycle, ensuring awareness of progress, confirming deadlines, understanding process or system changes, and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 CRM \& Relationship Management
   

  

 •Maintain and update the Head of Middle East’s contacts and relationship data in InterAction, ensuring activities, meetings and relationship notes are accurately recorded.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in managing and maintaining effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers, supporting collaboration across jurisdictions.
   

  

 •Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring referrals are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in ensuring referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow‑up on agreed actions and opportunities.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations), ensuring strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of initiatives impacting the region.
   

  

 •Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings, ensuring all Business Operations functions are kept informed, aligned and engaged on regional matters.
   

  

 •Use these forums to share relevant knowledge or developments that may impact specific functions, agree deliverables, and capture upcoming activities, deadline changes and requirements that should be on the Head of Middle East’s radar.
   

  

 •Ensure key outputs from Middle East Operations meetings are fed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings, promoting alignment and proactive planning across the region.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Person Specification
   

  

 •Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
   

  

 •Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi‑time‑zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
   

  

 •Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi‑destination itineraries, visas and short‑notice changes.
   

  

 •Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparation of draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
   

  

 •Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling review meetings, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
   

  

 •Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
   

  

 •Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
   

  

 •Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence drafting correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
   

  

 •Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
   

  

 •Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
   

  

 •Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
   

  

 •Professional, client‑focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior internal stakeholders and clients.
   

  

 •Fluent written and spoken English.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Benefits include (but are not limited to)
   

  

 •Competitive salary (negotiable depending on experience)
   

  

 •Premium international medical, dental, and optical insurance
   

  

 •30 days of annual leave
   

  

 •Employee Assistance Programme
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Competencies
   

  

 •Working together
   

  

 •Integrity and respect
   

  

 •Inclusive
   

  

 •Personal impact and growth
   

  

 •Driving high standards
   

  

 •Commercial mindset
   

  

 •Client \- centric
   

  

 •Responsible

**Job Description**
 As a global leader in aviation technologies, Honeywell Aerospace develops advanced products such as integrated cockpits, jet engines, and cutting\-edge connectivity solutions. Known for innovation and a strong focus on customer needs, Honeywell offers its employees the chance to work at the forefront of the aviation industry, shaping the future of flight.

 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced
 **Sales Manager for Aerospace Connectivity Solutions** 
 to drive our sales initiatives in the Business Aviation and Head of State markets in the Middle East, Africa and India region. This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong demonstrated background in airborne connectivity solutions and a proven ability to drive sales growth and customer satisfaction. The connectivity portfolio encompasses satellite communications for cabin Wi\-Fi, on\-board networks, cockpit datalink and safety services. The Sales Manager will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building client relationships, creating winning propositions, and achieving sales targets. This role requires a blend of commercial insight, industry and technical expertise, and sales acumen.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and Implement Sales Plans: Support the creation and execution of a robust sales strategy to grow the connectivity solutions business in the Business Aviation and Head of State markets.

* Consultative Sales: Apply deep knowledge of connectivity solutions to create compelling solutions and proposals to meet and exceed client requirements.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Work closely with customer account and support teams and regional leadership to help develop and execute growth strategies. Provide market intelligence and client feedback to offering management teams to inform product strategies.
* Negotiation and Closing: Support negotiation efforts with clients to secure win\-win solutions.
* Sales Forecasting and Reporting: Grow and manage sales pipeline within the CRM system.
* Brand Ambassador: Represent Honeywell Aerospace at industry events, conferences, and networking functions to enhance brand visibility and promote Honeywell connectivity solutions.


**Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of airborne connectivity solutions, including satellite communications services and hardware.

* Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets and driving business growth.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.


 Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret market trends and customer requirements are essential for success in this role.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle
