**Preferred Qualifications:** 




 Experience working with:
 


* Sovereign wealth funds (e.g. PIF, Mubadala, ADQ or equivalent)

* Investment funds or government\-linked entities in the GCC
* Background in technology, AI, energy, environmental, or urban development sectors

**Benefits Provided:**

We are hiring!
 



 Position: Project Control Manager
 



 Location: Lusail
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 We are looking for a highly competent Project Control and Reporting Manager to lead the planning, cost control, risk management, and reporting functions across infrastructure/local road projects. The ideal candidate will work closely with the Project Director to ensure project strategies align with cost, time, and profitability targets while maintaining strict control over risk exposure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 1\. Planning Management:
 


* Develop, monitor, and update detailed project schedules (Primavera P6 or equivalent).
* Coordinate with engineering and construction teams to align the schedule with actual site progress.
* Maintain baseline and look\-ahead schedules, and propose recovery plans when needed.



  





 2\. Cost Control:
 


* Establish, implement, and maintain a comprehensive cost control system.
* Monitor budgets, track expenditures, and update forecasts.
* Generate detailed cost reports with variance analysis and recommendations.



  





 3\. Risk Management:
 


* Identify and assess project risks.
* Develop risk mitigation and avoidance plans in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Continuously monitor risk triggers and take proactive action before issues materialize.
* Ensure early warnings and recommendations are communicated clearly and promptly to avoid project delays or cost overruns.



  





 4\. Procedures and Processes:
 


* Develop and enforce project control processes for planning, cost, and risk.
* Standardize reporting templates, workflows, and communication protocols across all projects.
* Ensure documentation and control measures are audit\-ready and aligned with company policies.



  





 5\. KPIs and Strategy Alignment:
 


* Define and monitor KPIs for schedule, cost, productivity, and risk.
* Prepare monthly performance dashboards and highlight deviations.
* Work closely with the Project Director to set project strategies, profit targets, and operational goals.
* Participate in strategic planning and forecasting sessions.



  





 6\. Reporting:
 


* Consolidate project data into high\-level executive reports.
* Ensure accuracy, clarity, and timeliness of all reporting outputs.
* Prepare materials for internal and client meetings.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* 20\+ years of experience in project control, cost, and planning roles within infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6, cost control software, and MS Office Suite.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Experience in multi\-project environments and strong coordination capabilities.



  





 Must have valid QID and NOC.

 At Qatar Airways, we craft cutting\- edge inflight products, enhance passenger comfort, and drive innovation in aviation design. From concept to launch, our Product Development and Design Team collaborates with industry leaders to create products that set new standards in travel. If you are passionate about innovation and design, this is your chance to make a lasting impact in the aviation industry. Join our Product Development and Design Team that transforms ideas into reality and shape the future of airline experiences!
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the divisional project portfolio through robust governance, data\-informed planning, and change enablement, working hand in hand with the Product Development \& Design (PDD) PMO team. You will ensure that all PDD initiatives are governed effectively, executed in accordance with best\-in\-class methodologies, and strategically synchronized with Qatar Airways governance forums such as the Group\-level Enterprise Program Management Office (EPMO). The role champions the PDD agenda in line with the GCEO vision and the direction set by the SVP Product Development \& Design, while fostering innovation and continuous improvement in how projects are planned, governed, and delivered.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

**Strategic Governance \& Synchronization**
* Establish and maintain a divisional project governance framework that ensures consistency, transparency, and adherence to the QR 2\.0 vision and the QR Group strategic priorities.
* Ensure synchronization of PDD project efforts with enterprise\-wide programs, including EPMO\-led initiatives, while maintaining focus on divisional priorities and outcomes.
* Translate the SVP PDD’s strategic direction into actionable governance practices that prioritize innovation, customer\-centricity, and design excellence.
* Promote the adoption of modern project management methodologies (e.g. Process Excellence / Lean Six Sigma, Agile, PMBOK) to elevate execution discipline and delivery quality across the division.
* Act as the strategic interface between PDD and enterprise governance bodies, ensuring seamless integration of reporting, planning cycles, and performance tracking.


**Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Monitoring**
* Oversee the PDD project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are prioritized, sequenced, and resourced in line with strategic objectives and enterprise transformation goals.
* Define and track success metrics (KPIs and OKRs) to support business case approvals with the investment committees, measure project impact, alignment, and execution effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools to provide leadership with real\-time visibility into project health, risks, and strategic alignment.

**Risk Management \& Continuous Improvement**
* Anticipate risks that may impact project delivery, strategic synchronization, or stakeholder engagement, and develop proactive mitigation strategies.
* Conduct regular governance reviews and audits to ensure compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements.
* Capture and share lessons learned to continuously refine planning and governance practices across the division.
* Champion a culture of accountability, transparency, and learning within the PDD project management community.

 As part of the Short \& Medium Range Air Defense Systems Product Area within the Land and Air Defense Systems (L\&ADS) Strategic Business Unit, the team has successfully delivered NASAMS systems to Qatar and is now transitioning into operations and sustainment, with opportunities for product modernization.

Serving as the primary point of contact for Qatar NASAMS execution efforts in Doha, you will work in partnership with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager to ensure a unified approach to program execution.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include managing subcontractor execution schedules with the KDA in\-country Project Manager to meet delivery commitments, supporting the CONUS Program Manager in preparing EACs and Program Review packages, and maintaining program infrastructure. This requires coordination across Raytheon functions, off\-sites, and international partners to ensure timely staffing, start\-up, and delivery of contractual products and services.
   

  

 You will lead in\-country teams for modernization, warranty, after\-sales support, repair \& return, and technical assistance, with responsibility for schedule and performance. This high\-visibility role involves daily interaction with the MRAD Directorate, regional and CONUS\-based functions, and senior\-level customer representatives, ensuring program success through cross\-functional collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.

* Oversee daily execution of the in\-country team, schedule, and performance for assigned contracts, ensuring compliance and fostering customer intimacy to support growth efforts.

data.jd_text:
Located on Al Udeid Airbase in Doha, the Qatar Technical Institute provides internationally recognized training programs to the Qatar Armed Forces, consisting of Foundation Training, General Engineering and Specialty Type Training. Supporting Qatar vision 2030, this ensures personnel are equipped with appropriate skills and knowledge for a career in the Armed Forces. The Senior Project Professional role is focused on both Project Management \& Project Control, including the operational day\-to\-day running of the Technical Institute, through to the mobilization of the long\-term Technical Institute solution. Working in a co\-located environment closely alongside the QAF customer, the role necessitates professionalism and maturity from the outset and is an excellent opportunity to obtain hands\-on experience in both a customer facing and training environment.
   

  

**The Role Will Include**
* Project Management \& Control of the delivery of Speciality Type Training
* Project Management ownership of various Major Work Elements, their CSR inputs and associated reporting requirements
* Project Management of the Technical Institute Resourcing Plan, and associated sub\-contracts
* Project Management of the Technical Institute Capacity Plan
* Ownership and management of a robust Technical Institute change process, retaining compliance with programme and organisational requirements
* Ensuring the Technical Institute adheres to BAE Systems Project Control \& Management governance, processes, and procedures
* Ensuring effective integration with the wider Qatar\-based organisation, namely the Facilities, MoB and Qatar Branch Office entities.
* Support to solution definition, requirement compilation/derivation and initial cost estimating for New Business opportunities


**Core Activity**
 The role will immediately deploy into Qatar with regular communications with various UK based functions.
   

  

**Day To Day Duties Include**
* Solution Definition Documentation through to the Statement of Requirements and Statements of Work for any New Business opportunities, alongside associated initial cost estimates and integration with functional representatives (e.g. Estimating / Commercial)
* Project Management Delivery activities associated with the Technical Institute Recurring Service Training Delivery
* Maintenance of the TI capacity planning tool, ensuring topicality at all times.
* Ownership of Resource Planning, Capacity Planning and any subsequent updates to sub\-contracts (BSL)
* Act as the focal point in the Technical Institute for BSL contract changes
* Act as the focal point for all Export Control queries
* Act at the focal point for the Technical Institute Change Control Process
* Compile underpinning data in support of the quarterly CSR
* Compile underpinning data in support of programme reporting (OPR, Risk \& Ops, CCB)
* Management of Technical Institute IT, including Project Management and Control challenge into CAM488 and their associated deliverables into the TI project, stand\-up of the service and associated transition to a recurring service delivery
* PM support to the stand\-up of Fusion Learning Management System
* Creation of periodic reports for all relevant, internal and external stakeholders. Ensuring Technical Institute progress is communicated effectively.
* Support to the delivery teams (e.g. Vocational Training Delivery) to track and report on budget, schedule, and quality.
* Support the Project Management Lead in Contract Status Report (CSR) reporting.
* Support to the Integrated Business Planning process.
* Management of project change through the QPO change management process.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as the focal point for the Technical Institute New Business, including initial solution development, cost estimating, and stakeholder engagement.
* Ensure that the TI capacity planner and resource planner is kept current and reviewed monthly with the TI leadership team to ensure topicality.
* Act as the focal point for all export licensing queries and compilation of draft license applications, for onward transmission by the Export Control Team.
* Collate designated slides for the Operational Performance Review pack for the TI, where necessary, collating inputs from other stakeholders/slide owners.
* In support of the Project Management Lead, collate the quarterly CSR inputs for each Major Work Element under your responsibility.
* Provide Project Management and Project Control ownership of all the requirements, enablers and delivery of Speciality Type Training and Information Management \& Technology (IM\&T)
* Facilitate strong integration links via regular communication with the Facilities organization and the Branch Office, supporting the Contract \& Assurance Manager in the development and implementation of an effective Communications Strategy.
* Management of BSL partner resource demand and associated budget, through periodic updates to contract documentation as required.


**Requirements**
 In an operational, fast paced setting, candidates must have:
   

  

* Strong organizational and motivational skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple priorities in a dynamic operating environment, working with a high degree of autonomy.
* Experience of communicating with the customer community whilst understanding the cultural sensitives of the Middle East environment.
* Ability to work in a diverse environment of varying nationalities, cultures and backgrounds.


**Working In This Role, Candidates Must Have**
* APM Project Management Qualification or IPMA Level D equivalent
* 5\-years’ experience working in complex Project Control systems
* Ability to discharge Project Management delivery and Project Control responsibilities in tandem
* Competent in the use of IT, spreadsheets, word processing and database management
* A desire to drive the increased use of cutting\-edge technology in the Technical Institute


 It would be highly desirable (but not necessary) for candidates to have:
   

  

* APM Project Professional Qualification (was APM Practitioner Qualification) or IPMA Level C equivalent
* Additional Language Skills pertinent to the Middle East environment

We are Hiring for Gulf Asia Contracting!!
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The Planning Manager is responsible for overseeing project planning, scheduling, and progress monitoring to ensure timely and efficient execution of projects. This role involves developing detailed project plans, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring alignment with project objectives, timelines, and resource allocation. The position plays a critical role in driving project efficiency, minimizing delays, and ensuring successful project delivery.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Develop, implement, and maintain detailed project schedules using appropriate planning tools
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables in coordination with stakeholders
* Monitor project progress and identify potential delays or risks, implementing corrective actions proactively
* Prepare and update project reports, dashboards, and progress tracking documentation
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to ensure alignment with project plans
* Analyze resource requirements and ensure optimal allocation of manpower, materials, and equipment
* Conduct variance analysis to compare planned vs. actual progress and recommend improvements
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, and company standards
* Support project management in decision\-making through data\-driven insights and planning reports
* Participate in project meetings and provide updates on schedule performance and key risks
* Implement planning best practices to improve efficiency and reduce project delays
* Maintain proper documentation of schedules, changes, and planning records



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related field
* Minimum 8–12 years of experience in project planning and scheduling
* Proven experience in large\-scale industrial, oil \& gas, or construction projects preferred
* Proficiency in planning tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, or equivalent
* Strong understanding of project management principles and methodologies

**Job Description**
 Wood is accepting expressions of interest for a Project Director (Offshore) to join our team in Qatar. This role create delivery excellence across assigned project/program/portfolio of projects, provide certainty and confidence to the customer/project sponsor, and robust control of project scope, schedule, cost and risk.
   

  

 Specifies and directs the implementation and completion of one or more major projects or programs, including responsibility for managing safety, scope, cost, schedule and risk, and ensuring appropriate reporting and governance is in place. Responsible for delivery of project(s)/program(s)/portfolio to agreed scope, specifications, schedule and budget, for managing change and customer relationships. Delivers project(s)/program(s)/portfolio which often involves a high level of complexity and risk with multiple workstreams and high financial risk. Oversight of multiple project managers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* P \& L responsibility with associated commercial and financial accountability including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination and attainment, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing and cash collection
* Contributes to and reviews the project proposal and plan to establish timeframe, procedures for accomplishing the project, resource requirements, and allotment of available resources to various phases of the project. Ensures adherence to corporate policy and best practice, and sets project evaluation parameters.
* Negotiates changes to project scope with the customer. Follows Change Management process to identify and approve modifications to scope, cost, schedule and quality
* Pursues and develop opportunities for innovation, such as digitalisation and technology use, work share and high value engineering centres, to bring value to Wood and customer
* Approves project procedures and project execution plan including the scope of work, deliverables list, master schedule, budget, org charts, risk register etc
* Ensures competence of project team members to carry out assigned work
* Oversees proposals and call\-offs (may be single projects) within delegation of authority, ensuring compliance with contracting policy and standards of ethical conduct.
* Monitors adherence to schedule, cost and quality and proactively intervenes to avoid slippage
* Ensures that the required project management software systems are established for the project and the supporting training is completed
* Ensure the project assurance protocol and schedule are established
* Involved in establishing terms and conditions, and wider scope and larger size of projects may require more visibility in the community as well as activity in attracting project staff
* Responsible for the project HSSE leadership, ensures a program of initiatives and auditing schedule are established, and that HSSE and quality management issues are proactively addressed
* Drives good practices, including corporate initiatives, across projects and programs
* Resolves complex issues which are escalated by project team
* Participate in assurance activities and peer reviews
* The complexity, potential impact and political sensitivity of projects/programmes of this size (particularly in an international context), frequently require the project director to be involved in closing the deal, attracting specialized staff from outside the organization, and managing relationships with local officials and community groups as well as the customer and contractors, all based on their credibility and proven track record


**Qualifications**
* University degree (bachelors or masters) in Engineering
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Associate in Project Management (APM) or equivalent certification is preferred
* Typically requires more than 20 years of broad and extensive pertinent experience, including minimum 10 years project management experience, mastering their area and knowledgeable about impacts on other areas; of which substantial experience successfully managing major/complex international or remote location projects.
* Requires strong technical skill as relevant to the project scope(s)
* Good level of experience in the related field, industry, and locations of the work
* Has thorough knowledge of project success and benefits management
* Expert in stakeholder management with extensive experience in managing challenging stakeholders and able to coach and advise others in this area
* Thorough understanding of requirements management from creation to monitoring to verification of complex project requirements and their linkage to business benefits.
* Knowledge of work flow management, established policies for engineering ownership, globalization of projects and request for tender process
* Experienced in assembling and managing multi\-phase project budgets, including risk contingencies
* Expert Practitioner in Risk Management processes, well versed in how risks are transposed into cost, time and contingency estimates and forecasts
* Advanced knowledge of various forms of vendor contracts across many types of goods and services; able to create new appropriate contracting frameworks and negotiate to successful conclusion.
* Able to manage complex major project start\-up, produce and communicate the project execution plan
* Expert understanding of both explicit and implicit dependencies and able to explain these and build into recommendations
* Experience of implementing successful project performance improvement activities and techniques for recovering poor performance
* Knowledge of supplier categorisation and experienced in devising appropriate commercial acquisition strategies
* Understands the needs of information management requirements in the project phases (operation), internal (contractual, statutory) and asset (customer) documentation.
* Able to negotiate appropriate close\-out terms with all key stakeholders.
* Ability to effectively manage resources (personnel, equipment, materials etc)
* Sound practice and experience of commercial and technical risk management.
* Able to drive cash flow management as well as projection/forecast of cost at completion


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to unlock solutions to critical challenges in energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in 45 countries, employing around 25,000 people. www.woodplc.com

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**Primary Objective**
 The Project Engineering Manager is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering framework for project execution, ensuring the effective delivery of multi\-disciplinary engineering and design activities across our onshore projects in Energy and hydrocarbon sectors.
   

  

**Specific Accountabilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Execution**
* Establish and implement the project engineering execution framework, including procedures, deliverables, workflows, and interface management.
* Lead and coordinate multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across Feasibility/ Concept, FEED and Detailed Design phases.
* Direct the preparation and quality of engineering deliverables, ensuring alignment with scope, standards, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant design output, meeting client specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Review and approve engineering execution strategies, project organization structures, and discipline responsibilities.
* Prepare and implement the Engineering management Plan on projects and ensure discipline schedules/budgets include safety and sustainability activities for the asset lifecycle.
* Manage technical Value Improvement Practices (VIPs) \- technology selection, value engineering, energy optimization, RAM, etc.


**Cross\-Discipline Coordination \& Interface Management**
* Provide overall integration across engineering disciplines, ensuring effective sequencing and interface management.
* Establish and maintain engineering coordination procedures with internal teams, licensors, contractors, and stakeholders.
* Oversee and manage interfaces between engineering, procurement, construction, and third\-party contractors.
* Ensure structured communication and resolution of technical queries and inter\-disciplinary conflicts.


**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure engineering activities comply with Worley standards, international codes, and customer specifications
* Must ensure maintaining engineering quality assurance processes, including document control, review cycles, and approval timelines.
* Lead the review and approval of key engineering documents, ensuring compliance with HSSEQ, operability, maintainability, and technical integrity requirements.
* Must ensure and participate in design reviews, safety studies, and technical assurance activities.
* Ensure required Technical Peer Reviews (TPRs) are planned, scheduled, and budgeted; proactively engage Location Director of Engineering when needed.


**Project Management \& Delivery**
* Overall key technical interface with customer management teams.
* Support the safe, on\-time, and within\-budget delivery of engineering scope across all project phases.
* Monitor engineering progress against schedule, budget, and deliverable milestones, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.
* Provide technical and commercial input to optimize design solutions and manage project risks.
* Ensure alignment between engineering outputs and project controls (cost, schedule, procurement needs).
* Maintain engineering registers for assumptions, holds, technical queries, deviations, key document changes, and SEAL decisions.


**HSSEQ \& Compliance**
* Champion Health, Safety, Security, Environment, and Quality culture within engineering activities.
* Ensure designs incorporate safe, sustainable, and environmentally compliant solutions.
* Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory frameworks and standards.


**Team Leadership \& Capability**
* Lead, mentor, and develop multi\-location engineering teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and competency.
* Ensure teams are appropriately staffed and aligned with project requirements.
* Foster collaboration across disciplines, offices, and stakeholders.
* Capture and implement lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Qualifications, Accreditation, Training**
**Education**
* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline of Engineering from an accredited University
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage
* MME (Ministry of Municipality and Environment) engineering accreditation is a mandatory requirement. Candidates not holding this accreditation must be willing to achieve this within the probationary period.


**Job Specific Knowledge , Experience \& Competencies**
* Significant experience in oil \& gas, petrochemical, or energy sector projects
* Must have proven experience as Project Engineering Manager / Engineering Manager on Pre\-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering projects during the last five years.
* Strong exposure to multi\-disciplinary engineering and global delivery teams


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, execution planning, and design assurance
* Extensive knowledge of cross\-discipline integration, interfaces, and sequencing
* Experience in engineering deliverables, specifications, and design review processesSolid understanding of project lifecycle phases (Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC)
* Familiarity with industry standards and customer specifications
* Experience in risk management, change management, and technical decision\-making


**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong leadership capability with ability to manage diverse, multi\-location teams
* Effective communicator with the ability to influence technical and commercial decisions
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to manage complexity and conflicting priorities
* High level of planning, organization, and execution discipline
* Ability to operate in fast\-paced, multi\-project environments


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.jd_text:
**JOB SUMMARY** 




 The Director \- Human Research Subjects Protection Program is responsible for the overall administration of the program for protecting human participants in research, including the oversight and implementation of, and compliance with, institutional policies and procedures, national statutes and regulations, and ethical and professional standards for the conduct of human research. The HRPP Director serves as the organization authority on relevant compliance issues and as a liaison between the organization and Ministry of Public Health.
 



 Responsibilities
 



  





**KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* Maintains the institution assurance of compliance with the Ministry of Public Health (MOPH) and the U.S. Office for Human Research Protections (OHRP) and ensures adherence to their terms for the protection of human subjects.
* Works collaboratively with the Chairs of regulatory committees, Department Chairs, institution administration to provide support, compliance monitoring and oversight, and facilitate ethical conduct of research.
* Oversees and coordinates HRPP activities across the various offices and staff that have roles in protecting research participants.
* Coordinates with Sidra’s Divisions and Units for implementing other aspects of human research protection programs and initiatives.
* Proactively creates or revises policies and procedures and corresponds guidance to assure consistency with best practices and evolving external policies from MOPH.
* Manages and supervises the staff that provides administrative and regulatory support to the IRB Committee.
* Develops, modifies and executes policies that affect immediate operation(s) and may also have organization\-wide effect.
* Coordinates efforts of the IRB Office staff to ensure thorough and timely reviews of all IRB submissions.
* Administers the Responsible Conduct of Research training coordination.
* Provides subject matter\-specific counsel to HRPP team members, Board members, and investigators.
* Ensures that human research protection training is available and completed by investigators, key study personnel, the Institutional Signatory Official, and all Sidra staff who participate in the human subject’s protection program.
* Oversees the quality assurance monitoring of the HRPP, including research protocols and investigation of matters of non\-compliance. Ensure implementation of corrective action, as needed, in accordance with Sidra policies and IRB policies and procedures.
* Serves as the organization authority on relevant compliance issues, and as a liaison between the organization and federal regulators,
* Oversees and is accountable for policies and procedures related to relevant compliance area.
* Reviews and approves recommendations for research compliance programs.
* Maintains current knowledge of human research protection guidance and regulations as they evolve. Stay current on emerging issues. Monitors MOPH regulatory websites and other research\-related resources so as to stay current with regulatory changes in human research protections guidelines and policies. Communicate pertinent information to staff in a timely manner.
* Establishes objectives and work plans, and delegate’s assignments to subordinate managers.
* Coordinates and participates in regulatory agency site visits and audits; analyzes and assesses audit findings and proposes and implements changes to HRPP policies and procedures to address findings, when needed.
* Manages, prepares, administers, and directs resources



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Education** 




 Bachelor’s Degree in biomedical field
 



  





**Experience** 




 10\+ years of experience with progressive responsibilities in the human subject protection program area or in other research protection programs, clinical research, or management of human research including:
 


* 5\+ years direct supervisory / management experience.
* Previous leadership experience combined with a proven and demonstrated track record of leading others and achieving outstanding results.
* Expertise and experience in supervision and oversight of IRBs at an Academic Medical Center
* Experience in budget management.



  





**Certification** 




 Council for Certification of IRB Professionals (CCIP) certification or willingness to obtain within six months.

* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.

* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.

* Reviews timesheets and forwards them to the Executive Chef for approval.
* May prepare a variety of reports and letters utilizing personal computer system and equipment.

* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
**Department:** 
 NUQ Library
   

  

 Northwestern University in Qatar (NU\-Q) seeks an outstanding Director of the NU\-Q Library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library guides a team of library professionals with vision and purpose in support of NU\-Q vision of excellence in teaching, research, and mediamaking. Reporting to the Associate Dean for Education, the Director of the NU\-Q Library will provide collaborative leadership and strategic direction to the programs, services, initiatives, and collections of the NU\-Q Library. The successful candidate will be a forward\-thinking professional who is enthusiastic about advancing research, teaching, learning, and practice through access to NU\-Q Library resources, and knowledgeable about the complex nature of building, supervising, managing, and mentoring a collaborative team. The Director of the NU\-Q Library will facilitate partnerships in education and knowledge creation within Northwestern and beyond.
   

  

**Core Mission**
* Commitment to the core mission of NU\-Q as a global community of evidence\-based storytellers guided by the core values of excellence, collaboration, community, and sustainability
* Leadership and Strategic Vision
* Administration and Supervision
* Campus Engagement
* Professional and Ethical Practices and Innovation
* Assessment and Continuous Improvement


 The NU\-Q Library is a user\-focused library and serves the research and educational needs of NU\-Q faculty, staff, and students. The growing collection is made up of print, DVD/Blu\-ray, and electronic resources purchased and provided to support the curricular needs of the Communication Program which offers Media Industries and Technology major, the Journalism and Strategic Communication Program which offers Journalism major, and the Liberal Arts Program. The NU\-Q Library’s core mission is to coordinate and deliver robust reference services both in\-person and online, supporting research and learning across disciplines.
   

  

 The Director of the NU\-Q Library supports the university leadership and is responsible for the overall management and administration of the NU\-Q library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library oversees all aspects of NU\-Q Library staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment. With a keen eye on strategic planning and strategic resource management, the Director of the NU\-Q Library develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence. As a passionate advocate for the NU\-Q Library's core mission and services, the Director of the NU\-Q Library builds strong relationships with campus leadership and stakeholders, championing the library's essential role in academic excellence and student success. Through thoughtful planning and continuous assessment, the Director of the NU\-Q Library drives the development of innovative research support services and information resources. By partnering with faculty, academic departments, and student support teams, the Director of the NU\-Q Library helps elevate community members’ learning outcomes and ensures the library remains a vital, evolving hub of intellectual engagement. The Director of the NU\-Q Library fosters a culture of shared governance; advances the library culture of assessment through data collection; engages in evidence\-based decision\-making practices; and promotes a culture of accessibility, accountability, innovation, and ethical practices.
   

  

 There are also opportunities to collaborate with NU\-Q’s Institute for Advanced Study of the Global South (IAS), Artificial Intelligence and Media Lab (AIM\-Lab), and Media Majlis Museum (MMM). The IAS in the Global South at NU\-Q (\#IAS\_NUQ) produces and promotes evidence\-based storytelling focused on the histories, cultures, societies, and media of the Global South. The AIM\-LAB at NU\-Q produces and promotes data\-based storytelling focused on the intersection of artificial intelligence and media. MMM at NU\-Q is a museum dedicated to exploring journalism, communication, media and art.
   

  

 In the era of digital technologies and AI, libraries in media schools need to transition from a conventional resource center into an active catalyst for digital storytelling, research advancement, and ethical media innovation. They curate and provide access to multimedia collections, data journalism resources, AI\-driven production tools, and cutting\-edge media technologies. Beyond access, libraries in media schools are expected to cultivate advanced information literacy, AI literacy, critical understanding of algorithms, copyright compliance, academic integrity, and responsible AI integration in creative projects. They partner with faculty, staff, and students to confront misinformation, deepfakes, and data ethics challenges while upholding the highest standards of media research, media production, journalism practice, and creative scholarship.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ph.D. in a subject area relevant to the core mission of Northwestern University in Qatar (communication studies, media studies, media design, cinema studies, journalism studies, liberal arts, etc.)


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) from an ALA\-accredited program.
* Minimum of 6 years of successful progressive leadership experience in university libraries (e.g., Assistant Director of Library and then Associate Director of Library required to support the Director of Library).
* Proven experience in and strong record of supervising, training, mentoring, and evaluating librarian faculty and staff members, fostering professional growth, contribution, and collaboration
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing and delivering library faculty/staff development programs
* Proven experience in and strong record of annual assessment of library services and implementation of long\-term strategies for the growth and innovation of library services
* Proven experience in and strong record of data collection and data analytics to inform evidence\-based decision\-making and service improvements
* Proven experience in and strong record of assessment of the effectiveness of library services, spaces, and collections in advancing student success and academic excellence
* Proven experience in and strong record of adoption of emerging technologies and innovative practices to enhance access, discovery, and research support
* Proven experience in and strong record of development and implementation of strategic initiatives that support institutional goals and accreditation requirements
* Proven experience in and strong record of university teaching and instructional design for information literacy
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing programs that showcase the role of university libraries in research, curricular use, and community engagement
* Proven experience in strategic planning, assessment practices, and advocacy in higher education environments.
* Proven experience in and strong record of building and maintaining effective partnerships and collaborations between the library, university leadership, academic departments, and the broader university community
* Proven experience in and strong record of dedication to student success
* Solid understanding of the organizational structure, organizational workflows, and approval chains in top\-tier universities
* Extensive knowledge of a broad range of issues and emerging trends in managing, collecting, and providing access to academic/university libraries
* Knowledge of Open Education Resources (OER) and affordable learning initiatives
* Comprehensive familiarity with the current trends in academic libraries, media schools, digital scholarship, and student learning support.
* Proven experience in budget and grant development and management
* Excellent communication, collaborative, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Strong record of professional engagement and contribution, such as research, publications, and involvement in professional and scholarly organizations
* Strong record of progressively responsible experience working with a multidisciplinary team in academic/university libraries, including supervisory and leadership roles.
* Proven experience in and strong interest in applying new and emerging technologies to Library collections and archives, including digital scholarship and digital humanities initiatives
* Ability to demonstrate a calm, courteous, and professional demeanor when working with a variety of situations and/or people.
* Vision for leveraging emerging technologies, including the ethical application and use of artificial intelligence for library resources, services, and assessment
* Experience with collection development and maintenance, including databases and resources


***Please note this position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.***
**Responsibilities**
* Provide leadership to and management of a forward\-thinking NU\-Q Library, by playing a dynamic leadership role, guiding a team of library professionals with vision and purpose
* Oversee all aspects of staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment
* With a keen eye on strategic resource management, the Director develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence.
* Articulate a compelling vision for the NU\-Q Library and the value of the NU\-Q Library in supporting research, teaching, learning, and community engagement that aligns with the NU\-Q Library’s core mission and strategic directions
* Provide vision for NU\-Q Library collection development and stewardship. Establish priorities and develop policies that guide the development of library collections in alignment with the core mission of NU\-Q
* Establish strategic directions and priorities for a range of user\-centered services and programs that create exceptional experiences for the Northwestern community in support of their research, teaching, learning and practice with NU\-Q Library resources
* Provide leadership and oversight to the development of staff development programs and initiatives that establish the NU\-Q Library as a dynamic and innovative teaching and learning resource at Northwestern
* Provide overall direction for a team of 7 librarian faculty and staff members. Directly supervise Library faculty/staff members including librarians, library associate, and library assistants. Coordinate the department work. Provide mentorship, advocacy and support to all department staff and foster their professional engagement and growth
* Build and nurture collaborations and partnerships within the library, with faculty, academic departments, and the broader Northwestern community that strengthen and promote the key role and core mission of the NU\-Q Library in research, teaching, and community engagement
* Collaborate with library departments to advance the library’s digital transformation agenda to broaden discovery, access, and preservation of primary source materials in support of research and academic pursuits
* Represent the NU\-Q library in initiatives and events related to the strategic vision and priorities of the university within and outside NU\-Q. Contribute to the library’s leadership role in the field through projects, presentations, scholarship, and active participation in relevant professional organizations


**The anticipated salary range is $100,000 – $110,000 Commensurate with experience and qualifications.** 
 The pay offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on factors including (but not limited to) the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate including years since terminal degree, training, and field or discipline; departmental budget availability; internal comparators; and external market pay for comparable jobs.
   

  

 NU\-Q is a community of evidence\-based storytellers in the Global South. We are a globally embedded institution, being one of three campuses of Northwestern University (Chicago, Doha, Evanston) and one of several partner universities in the Qatar Foundation’s Education City in Doha, Qatar. Our mission is to mentor and educate students to become creative, ethical, and impactful communicators across cultural and national boundaries. We are committed to a vibrant student life, academic excellence, and high\-level undergraduate student research and media making, particularly on the Global South. Located at the confluence of continents, NU\-Q is a multidisciplinary global community with approximately 500 students from 60 countries.
   

  

 NU\-Q provides competitive compensation and benefits. The medium of instruction is English, but proficiency in Arabic or another regional language is an advantage at NU\-Q. Candidates with experience in US higher education as well as in the Arab region are particularly encouraged to apply. Northwestern University in Qatar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

 Applications received by
 **June 1, 2026** 
 , will receive the highest priority so that the start date can be as early as possible. The search will continue until the position is filled or the search closed.
   

  

 Please read ALL instructions and make preparations before proceeding to the application page:
   

  

* Applications will only be accepted via online submission (see link below).
* Please prepare all documents in advance as Adobe PDF files, and please be sure all information is entered correctly and accurately (especially names and email addresses), as there will be no opportunity for online revision after your application has been submitted.
* Please also prepare a list of names and email addresses for your external academic references; your references will be contacted directly by the online system and invited to upload their letters on your behalf.

***Role Overview***




 The Sr. Analyst, Corporate Development is a high\-visibility, strategically critical role sitting within the Corporate Development Office. We are hiring two Senior Analysts who will share the same mandate — supporting the Group's strategic agenda and driving cross\-vertical initiatives — but with distinct areas of focus. Both roles report to the Sr. Director, Corporate Development, and will report directly to the Holding CEO on an interim basis until the Sr. Director is onboarded.
 



 The ideal candidate brings 7–8 years of experience from a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG) or equivalent top\-tier strategy practice, with a proven ability to operate in large, multi\-sector organisations.

 ● Strategy Development \& Business Planning

 ● Strategic Initiatives Custodian across the Group
 



 ● Group\-level Strategic Performance Tracking

 ● Change Management \& Adoption
 



 ● Operational Optimisation \& Process Improvement
 



 ● Margin Enhancement across Business Verticals
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***

 ● Identify operational inefficiencies across business verticals and develop structured improvement roadmaps to drive margin enhancement.
 



 ● Develop programme governance frameworks, progress tracking tools, and reporting mechanisms to ensure accountability and on\-time delivery.

 ● Maintain a transformation portfolio view, providing regular progress updates to the Sr. Director and Holding CEO.
 



  





***Qualifications \& Experience***




  





***Essential***




 ● 7–8 years of professional experience, with a significant portion in a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG) in a strategy, transformation, or management consulting capacity.

 ● Exposure to GCC or MENA markets, with understanding of regional business dynamics and regulatory environments.

 ● Executive Presence — Credible and composed when engaging with the CEO, Board, and senior business leaders.
 



 ● Problem Solving — Structured, hypothesis\-driven thinker who thrives in ambiguity and complexity.

data.jd_text:
**Commissioning Hull Lead \- FPSO** 




  





**Company Overview** 




 A leading global EPCM contractor delivering major offshore and onshore energy and infrastructure projects worldwide. The organisation operates across multiple business lines including Asset\-Based Services, Drilling, Energy Carriers, Offshore Wind, Sustainable Infrastructure, and Robotics \& Industrialised Solutions.
 



  





 The company is committed to engineering innovation, digital transformation, and supporting clients through the global energy transition towards Net Zero. It operates in more than 50 countries and employs a highly diverse international workforce.
 



  





**Mission** 




 To ensure effective execution of all home office commissioning\-related activities, including pre\-commissioning, commissioning, start\-up, testing, training, operation, and final handover of the FPSO hull and systems to the client.
 



 All activities must be delivered in compliance with project requirements for safety, quality, cost control, and schedule adherence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Engineering \& Documentation Control** 



* Review contractual and technical project documentation
* Ensure commissioning, start\-up, training, and operation requirements are fully integrated into engineering deliverables
* Review and validate operating manuals and performance test procedures
* Review 3D model compliance for accessibility, operability, and commissioning requirements



  





**Planning \& Execution Management** 



* Participate in project planning and scheduling activities
* Develop and maintain commissioning, pre\-commissioning, start\-up, testing, training, and handover execution plans
* Define commissioning systems, priorities, and handover sequencing
* Ensure preparation of integrated commissioning schedules, including logistics and mobilisation planning



  





**Vendor \& Subcontractor Coordination** 



* Review licensor and vendor schedules for commissioning\-related activities
* Support procurement and subcontracting teams in defining scopes of work
* Assist in defining commissioning spare parts and consumables requirements
* Ensure alignment between vendor deliverables and commissioning execution strategy



  





**HSE \& Compliance** 



* Support development of the project HSE plan for commissioning activities
* Ensure HSE requirements are embedded in pre\-commissioning and commissioning procedures
* Participate in HAZOP reviews where required
* Support compliance with international maritime and offshore regulations (IMO, SOLAS, MARPOL, ISPS Code, Classification Society rules)



  





**Systems \& Performance Assurance** 



* Define commissioning systems boundaries and turnover priorities
* Verify KPIs during home office engineering phase
* Ensure readiness for test run and performance testing activities
* Support preparation for start\-up and operational readiness activities



  





**Procurement \& Technical Support** 



* Ensure preparation and review of technical requisitions and evaluations within commissioning scope
* Support engineering teams in resolving commissioning\-related technical issues
* Ensure alignment of procurement packages with commissioning requirements



  





**Offshore / Operations Readiness** 



* Ensure operability and maintainability considerations are incorporated into design
* Support vessel readiness for operational phase compliance with international regulations
* Ensure smooth transition from construction to commissioning and operations phases



  





**Candidate Requirements** 



* Strong experience in FPSO / offshore commissioning or marine systems commissioning
* Proven background in pre\-commissioning, commissioning, and start\-up phases
* Experience in large\-scale EPC/EPCM offshore energy projects
* Strong understanding of vendor coordination and system completion processes
* Knowledge of offshore regulatory frameworks (IMO, SOLAS, MARPOL, ISPS, Class rules)
* Strong planning, coordination, and technical review capability
* Fluent in English (additional languages beneficial)

**Job Title: Tax Analyst**




**Department: Advance Tax Rulings Section, Tax Policy Department** 




**Role purpose** 




 To deliver high\-quality technical analysis, research, and drafting that supports timely and consistent Advance Tax Ruling (ATR) decisions. The postholder will contribute to the full case lifecycle, ensuring analytical accuracy, procedural consistency and effective collaboration across technical and operational teams.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



1. **Technical support and drafting**


* Analyze ruling applications and supporting documentation to identify key issues.
* Research and interpret tax legislation, regulations, guidance, and relevant case law.
* Draft rulings, issue lists, and technical memoranda under the supervision of the Senior Tax Analyst.
* Prepare concise and well\-referenced summaries and comparative analyses.



  




1. **Case execution and collaboration**


* Coordinate with the Case Manager in ensuring completeness, document version control, and adherence to deadlines.
* Liaise with applicants to clarify information requests and coordinate responses for additional documentation.
* Prepare ruling case packs, meeting minutes, and decision logs for Senior Tax Analyst review.



  




1. **Quality and knowledge management**


* Apply approved templates, citations, and style guides consistently.
* Maintain and tag technical materials for future reference in the knowledge base.
* Track similar rulings to promote consistency and identify emerging policy trends.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 




**Essential** 



* A certified Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, such as Law, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, Economics, Public Administration.
* Minimum of four years of experience in tax advisory, tax administration, or tax policy.
* Strong understanding of domestic tax laws, regional tax frameworks, and administrative practice.
* Proven analytical and legal interpretation skills and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with legal, policy or audit teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication in Arabic and proficiency in English.



  





**Desirable** 



* Professional certifications such as CPA, ADIT, or CTA.
* Exposure to project management and information security basics.



  





**Core competencies** 



* Analytical rigor and research discipline.
* Clear and concise drafting with accurate citation.
* Proactive communication and effective team collaboration.
* Professional judgment, integrity and confidentiality.
* Reliability and adaptability under pressure and shifting priorities.



  





  





**Job Title: Senior Tax Analyst**




**Department: Advance Tax Rulings Section, Tax Policy Department** 




**Role purpose** 




 The Senior Tax Analyst is responsible for leading the technical review and drafting of Advance Tax Rulings (ATRs), ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Qatari tax law and procedural standards. The postholder provides expert analysis, mentors junior analysts, and contributes to the quality, efficiency, and integrity of the rulings process
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



1. **Technical analysis and drafting**


* Lead the technical assessment of ruling applications, ensuring comprehensive analysis of facts and evidence.
* Interpret legislation, executive regulations, guidance, and relevant case law to support conclusions with validation and clear rationale.
* Draft technically sound high quality rulings and supporting memoranda, articulating options, risks, and impact of precedents.
* Identify information gaps and frame targeted clarification questions for applicants.



  




1. **Collaboration and review**


* Work closely with the Case Manager to ensure completeness, accuracy and adherence to case milestones.
* Coordinate with Legal Counsel, Audit, Policy, and Transfer Pricing specialists on cross\-functional cases.
* Review, augment and consolidate the draft work produced by Tax Analysts into a single structured package for Legal Counsel and Head of Section feedback.



  




1. **Hearings and stakeholder engagement**


* Participate in technical discussions, hearings and briefings, presenting findings clearly and objectively.
* Lead the preparation and delivery of concise technical briefings to the Head of Section .
* Contribute to controlled publication and redaction where applicable.



  




1. **Quality, governance, and improvement**


* Apply approved templates, citation standards, and documentation protocols consistently.
* Monitor the consistency of treatment across similar rulings to ensure fairness and legal soundness.
* Recommend updates to guidance materials, FAQs, and procedural templates based on case experience and emerging issues.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 




**Essential** 



* A certified Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, such as Law, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, Economics, and Public Administration.
* Minimum seven years of experience in tax advisory, tax administration, or tax policy.
* In\-depth knowledge of domestic tax laws and related regulations, regional tax frameworks, international standards, and administrative practice.
* Strong legal interpretation and analytical skills with the ability to frame issues logically and persuasively.
* Excellent drafting ability, including clear reasoning and defensible conclusions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic with proficiency in English.
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with legal, policy or audit teams.



  





**Desirable** 



* CPA, ADIT, CTA, or an equivalent.



  





**Core competencies** 



* Technical depth with pragmatic judgment.
* Structured thinking and precision in drafting.
* Coaching and mentoring of junior staff.
* Integrity, confidentiality, and professional independence.
* Effective time management and Service Level Agreement discipline.

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 14th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online via the button below.
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Please write the Job Description.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**Required Skills/Abilities**

 Mandarin Oriental, Doha is an intimate and stylish urban retreat, blending Qatari\-influenced heritage with modern design. Located in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, within walking distance to Souq Waqif, Museum of Islamic Art and a short distance to the business district, West Bay.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Based at Mandarin Oriental, Doha within the Commercial Strategy Department in Doha, the Director of Commercial Strategy is responsible for setting the hotel’s strategic business direction by balancing financial objectives, managing sales segments and guiding the commercial strategies of the hotel. Works with General Manager, Director of Marketing Communications and Director of Revenue to develop and implement the hotels commercial strategy to maximize hotel revenues, market share performance and profits. Director of Marketing and Director of Revenue will report directly to the Director of Commercial Strategy. Responsible for maximizing revenue and profit associated with rooms, function space and total revenue as required. Position is accountable for all transient, group and catering segments and deployment, pricing, channel distribution and positioning. Identifies future revenue opportunities and effectively communicates strategies to the sales and marketing colleagues. Oversees the Revenue department and all the processes associated with them such as demand, revenue, forecasting, inventory management, channel management and proactive opportunity analysis. Oversees both the Revenue Department and the Marketing Department, including all processes associated with demand, revenue, forecasting, inventory management, channel management, proactive opportunity analysis, and marketing communications. The Director of Commercial Strategy reports to the General Manager.
   

  

**As Director of Commercial Strategy, you will be responsible for the following duties:**
* Together with Director of Marketing Communications and Director of Revenue Management, prepares the hotel’s annual budget and develops, implements and adapts the Annual Marketing Plan as market conditions fluctuate.
* Responsible for annual expenditure for all sales activities and control of the budgeted expenditure by a monthly forecast.
* Develops the business outlook and commercial strategy for the hotel and ensures the strategies conform to MOHG’s brand philosophies, guidelines and initiatives at all times.
* Provides strategic direction as it related to pricing, inventory, channel management and distribution of all market segments in accordance to MOHG’s brand guidelines.
* Proactively analyzes and communicates business trends and booking pace in comparison to the market, last year, forecast and budget.
* Analyzes competitive sets, price positioning, seasonality, mix and displacement on a weekly basis.
* Establishes and maintains effective and rational pricing strategies for all inventories and market segments.
* Oversees the annual pricing process for transient, group and catering rooms, function spaces and other areas as required.


**As Director Of Commercial Strategy, We Expect From You**
* Senior School qualifications and Degree or Higher National Diploma equivalent in Hospitality Management.
* Minimum 10\-year experience in Revenue Management
* Must have minimum 10\-year experience in Sales with MOHG or another similar hotel company
* Leadership experience minimum of 10 years with experience in handling all sales segments
* Experience of minimum 5 years of managing large teams.
* Preferable to experience in the GCC.


**Our commitment to you**
* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the \#MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Heath \& Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work\-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
* Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.
* A competitive salary and benefits packages
